meta.plot: MOAH. Différent. Une mère qui s’inquiète un peu trop. Un père absent. Un chef qui n’écoute jamais ses idées. Des acolytes jaloux et méchants. Zéro perspective d’évolution. Puis il y a ce logement dans une zone à risque. Cette belle étrangère qui ne le remarque pas. Des voisins terriblement dangereux. Bref, la vie de MOAH est compliquée. Et le fait que ce soit il y a 45.000 ans n’arrange pas vraiment les choses.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E01 - Shelter From The Storm
1.plot: After the death of her parents, Jax matriculates at the Fleet Training Academy on Earth where she learns to defend the Galaxy from intergalactic threats and makes a new family of friends, but also makes a shocking discovery about her own identity.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E02 - Chimes of Freedom
1.plot: When Atria Nine learns that Adari leader, Seeker Creston Hubbell, will be speaking on campus, she enlists the help of Jax and the study group to stand up against her former masters to help free her clone sisters and brothers from oppression on her homeworld.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E03 - Masters of War
1.plot: A war veteran from the legendary space battle cruiser Sea Hawk makes a shocking revelation to Jax and Greg  that could lead Jax to discover who actually killed her parents.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E04 - I Shall Be Released
1.plot: Jax joins Xander and her fellow cadets in responding to an emergency distress call from a secret lab, only to discover that a deadly experiment has infected the scientists and the cadets.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E05 - Most Likely You Go Your Way (And I'll Go Mine)
1.plot: Thomas's telepathic father arrives on campus and tries to enlist his estranged son in a dangerous heist in which nothing is as simple as it appears.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E06 - What Was It You Wanted
1.plot: When Pilar's bio-organic implants are hacked, Jax and Ralen lead an investigation to help save their friend and find out who's responsible and stop them from continuing to torment Pilar.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E07 - Time out of Mind
1.plot: Jax discovers a deadly secret from her past that she is desperate to understand with the help of Ralen and Pilar while the CIS grows increasingly suspicious of Xander’s divided loyalties.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E08 - Under the Red Sky
1.plot: When Xander enlists Jax on a dangerous mission in which she must rekindle a relationship with an old flame, Xander, must confront his own feelings for Jax and question if all orders are meant to be obeyed.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E09 - It Ain't Me Babe
1.plot: Trapped on an alien world, Jax, Xander and Ralen are stranded with no way home. They must band together to survive, but divided loyalties threaten to destroy them from within. And Jax will ultimately be forced decide her allegiances if they make it through the long night.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E10 - Hurricane
1.plot: Ralen is on trial for his life after being accused of having sabotaged the Tereshkova. But even Jax has her doubts about Ralen's veracity when his wife arrives from Zatar to defend him.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E11 - I'll Be Your Baby Tonight
1.plot: As the Fleet Academy, students prepare to celebrate Armistice Day (the anniversary of the end of the Zatarians war), Jax continues to struggle with the revelation that Ralen is married. Meanwhile, Ralen must decide where his loyalties truly lie.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E12 - Knocking on Heaven's Door
1.plot: Jax and Xander have their hands full as a dangerous cat-and-mouse game erupts on campus. Various parties from across the galaxy arrive on Earth, all in pursuit of Jax, during which she encounters a surprise ally who not only protects Jax, but also sheds light on who she really is. Meanwhile, Atria joined by Pilar, bravely explores her new life mission on Adar, helping her clone brothers and sisters, while Thomas searches for his missing father and Ralen contemplates his return to Zatar.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E13 - Simple Twist of Fate
1.plot: Picking up the pieces from the attack on the Fleet Training Academy by Leone Vokk, Jax and Xander must confront Tierney to stop her sinister plans for galactic domination while Atria's grassroots movement on Adar to run for Seeker may have serious consequences for the clones as well as her friends.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - Things Have Changed
2.plot: Jax and Xander try to track down a fugitive who is searching for a destructive weapon that could destroy the universe and Jax comes face-to-face with her mother.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Don't Think Twice, It's All Right
2.plot: Jax, Xander, Ralen, and Matta track the fugitives Tierney and Jax's mother, Eve, to a remote planet with a mysterious secret, only to come into the crosshairs of the planet's strange religious cult, who will stop at nothing to maintain their sinister order.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - Gates of Eden
2.plot: Jax and the team visit the distant planet where Professor Osborn first discovered Jax as an infant during the Earth-Zatarian War in an attempt to find the Ancients in the hopes of saving our Universe. But is dealt a tragic blow when Ralen suffers a loss that will change him forever.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - Beyond Here Lies Nothin'
2.plot: Jax and the team go in search of a lost alien race that may be the key to saving the universe, but they find themselves plagued by disturbing nightmares that arise out of each individual's personal traumas and most personal fears.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - On a Night Like This
2.plot: Xander and Jett set out to save Ralen, who has gotten caught up in the high stakes world of an intergalactic fight club. Meanwhile, Jax is on a mission for Osborn to acquire intel from a beautiful Sumi princess who is about to get married, but finds herself falling for Jax.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - Pay in Blood
2.plot: Xander, Ralen, and Jett help defend a mining colony in the Outer Rim that is under constant siege from Sumi Pirates. Meanwhile, back at the Academy, Jax is recruited by Osborn for a secret mission.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E07 - A Fool Such As I
2.plot: Xander, Ralen, and Jett discover and track a consignment of illegal weapons to a freighter captained by a desperate cargo pilot, Roy Scantron, where they discover the cargo is clones of dead EarthCom soldiers.

meta.plot: Pleine de ressources, Jax a dû très tôt apprendre à se débrouiller seule après le décès de ses parents. Une nouvelle vie s'offre à elle quand elle décide d'intégrer la Earth's Space Training Academy. La jeune femme y apprend à protéger et défendre la galaxie des menaces extraterrestres comme humaines. Quand des secrets sur ses origines remontent à la surface, Jax doit découvrir la vérité : sera-t-elle la sauveuse de l’humanité ou l’instrument de sa destruction ?

meta.plot: Laura intègre le lycée Ichio cours d’année. Elle y rencontre Julie, sa nouvelle meilleure amie et, surtout, une bande de cinq élèves très étranges, les Joyeux Loufoques, une brochette de cancres survoltés réunis par leur physique atypique et leurs multiples redoublements. Toujours prêts à distraire leurs camarades pendant les cours, les Joyeux Loufoques font le désespoir de leur professeur, mademoiselle Hilary. Celle-ci n'hésite pas à employer la manière forte pour les punir, mais c'est souvent peine perdue.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Tensions rise as the search for suspects begins. Michelle Calderone pumps the brakes on her personal life. Dave Gudsen gets creative.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E02 - Your Happy Makes Me Sad
1.plot: Seemingly stalled, Gudsen and Calderone consider a new lead. Chaos ensues on a side mission. Freddy Fasano rethinks his future.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E03 - Weird Milk
1.plot: Calderone charts her own course for answers. Gudsen pitches a new path for their partnership. Freddy heads to Coop's headquarters.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E04 - Strawberry
1.plot: Gudsen sheds light on his dark past. Calderone digs even deeper. Freddy starts to spiral.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E05 - Size Matters
1.plot: While Gudsen heads out of town for a conference, Calderone tries to track down his old partner. Freddy seeks revenge.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E06 - Manhood
1.plot: Esposito and Calderone urge Harvey to take action. A fully rogue Freddy reaches out to an ally.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E07 - Whitewashed Tombs
1.plot: On the heels of heartache, Calderone clocks in for a covert mission. Gudsen navigates newfound glory—and an unexpected confrontation.

1.title: FR - Smoke - S01E08 - Mercy
1.plot: Gudsen flips the script. Harvey grapples with regret. Calderone is forced to confront her past.

meta.plot: Quand un enquêteur incendie doit faire équipe avec une lieutenante, leur traque de deux pyromanes se transforme en jeu du chat et de la souris.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When a crisis at LAX prevents dozens of airplanes from landing, the government brings in a group of misfit geniuses to sort things out.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E02 - Single Point of Failure
1.plot: The governor calls on Team Scorpion when his daughter is mysteriously "bio-hacked" with a deadly virus and only has 24 hours to live. The case takes on a deeper significance for Walter after he receives a letter regarding his sister.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E03 - A Cyclone
1.plot: After failing a military training mission, the team members are determined to prove themselves when an Internet infrastructure is threatened by a bomber.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E04 - Shorthanded
1.plot: Against Cabe's advice, Team Scorpion heads to Las Vegas for a simple casino job, but a robbery leads to Walter's arrest and the rest of the team is left to clear his name.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E05 - Plutonium Is Forever
1.plot: To fix a Los Angeles nuclear reactor that's on the verge of a cataclysmic meltdown, Walter and the team must reluctantly enlist the help of a troubled former member.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E06 - True Colors
1.plot: The members of Team Scorpion must pass a mandated psych evaluation or face being disbanded after they're accused of destroying a priceless work of art in an attempt to protect an art exhibit. Paige enlists the help of the team when Ralph is reluctant to go to his school's Halloween party.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E07 - Father's Day
1.plot: A case gets personal for Team Scorpion when three convicts break out of prison and one of them is a brilliant hacker who was forced to help the others steal billions online. Meanwhile, Paige must manage Ralph's expectations when his father returns.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E08 - Risky Business
1.plot: Team Scorpion enlists the help of a musician who created a controversial algorithm that generates hit songs to help find the murderer of a music blogger.  Meanwhile, Drew asks Walter to help him connect with his son.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E09 - Rogue Element
1.plot: Team Scorpion try to protect Cabe's ex-wife, after she uncovers evidence that suggests foul play in the death of a prominent congressman.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E10 - Talismans
1.plot: When a military plane is shot down in Bosnia, Team Scorpion must help recover its stealth technology before it falls into enemy hands. Meanwhile, Walter's sister takes a break from her MS treatment and spends time at the garage with Sylvester

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E11 - Revenge
1.plot: When Sylvester accidentally triggers an explosive device during an investigation, Team Scorpion must focus on finding who's responsible even while their friend's life hangs in the balance.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E12 - Dominoes
1.plot: On Christmas Eve, Team Scorpion races to find a way to save a young boy's life after he is trapped in a beachside cave and the rising tide threatens to drown him.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E13 - Kill Screen
1.plot: Team Scorpion must help Ralph when the FBI questions him after his dark web game play inadvertently reveals the location of a CIA safe house and results in the murder of CIA operatives.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E14 - Charades
1.plot: Team Scorpion is tasked with uncovering a mole inside the CIA who is being coerced into stealing deadly chemicals. Paige gives Walter a flirting lesson in preparation for the case.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E15 - Forget Me Nots
1.plot: Team Scorpion must jog the memory of an injured former Secret Service agent to prevent nuclear weapons from being launched. Meanwhile, Paige is torn when Drew suggests that moving to Maine might be the best for Ralph.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E16 - Love Boat
1.plot: Team Scorpion goes undercover on a cruise ship to locate and disable deadly stolen rockets. Meanwhile, as Valentine's Day approaches, Toby and Happy help Ralph, who is in the throes of his first crush.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E17 - Going South
1.plot: A tech billionaire hires Team Scorpion to rescue his kidnapped daughter. Meanwhile, some feelings get hurt when Walter gives an interview and fails to acknowledge the other members of the team.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E18 - Once Bitten, Twice Die
1.plot: When a conflict in Eastern Europe threatens to escalate, Team Scorpion is called on to help facilitate secret peace talks to prevent World War III.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E19 - Young Hearts Spark Fire
1.plot: While on a mission to save lost hikers, Team Scorpion’s helicopter crashes, igniting a massive wildfire that quickly closes in on them. Also, Sylvester must help their injured pilot who is unable to make it to safer ground.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E20 - Crossroads
1.plot: To protect a key witness who is en route to testifying against a deadly drug cartel, Team Scorpion takes her on the run, with the cartel hot on their heels.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E21 - Cliffhanger
1.plot: Walter finally learns Cabe’s long-kept secret regarding the Baghdad mission, and it threatens to tear Team Scorpion apart forever.  Also, Paige’s world is rocked when Ralph puts his life in danger to help the team.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E22 - Postcards from the Edge
1.plot: Scorpion, torn apart and uncertain about their future as a team, must come together for their most important mission yet – to save Walter’s life as his car teeters on the side of a cliff.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E01 - Satellite of Love
2.plot: The new Director of Homeland Security, Adriana Molina, reunites the team when a nuclear powered Russian satellite is knocked out of orbit and must be diverted before it detonates over Southern California. Paige and Walter face their feelings for each other when hospital footage reveals that Paige kissed him.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E02 - Cuba Libre
2.plot: Team Scorpion heads to Cuba when a woman from Cabe’s past pleads for him to help catch a Serbian war criminal.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E03 - Fish Filet
2.plot: Sylvester goes undercover in a federal prison in order to save the lives of three judges, but the team must help him escape when his life is threatened.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E04 - Robots
2.plot: Walter, Cabe and Happy are trapped with the crew in a top secret submarine when an explosion sends it to the bottom of the ocean with limited oxygen and a self-destruct function that will soon activate.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E05 - Super Fun Guys
2.plot: Team Scorpion goes undercover on the “Super Fun Guy” movie set in Kazakhstan in order to disable a soviet era nuclear missile being sold by terrorists.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E06 - Tech, Drugs, and Rock 'n Roll
2.plot: Walter’s attempt to “normalize” goes horribly wrong when a nefarious virus is uploaded to his computer, turning Team Scorpion’s new “smart” building project into a burning death trap with people locked inside.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E07 - Crazy Train
2.plot: Team Scorpion must stop a sabotaged runaway subway train with Paige and Ralph on board. Also, in his attempt to impress Happy, Toby has his first boxing match.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E08 - Area 51
2.plot: Team Scorpion helps the CIA locate a top-secret aircraft in Area 51 in order to raise money for Walter's research to save his sister's life.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E09 - US vs. UN vs. UK
2.plot: Team Scorpion is blackmailed to break into the United Nations to assist in the assassination of a menacing arms dealer. Also, Sylvester makes a bold move to protect Megan's wishes.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E10 - Arrivals and Departures
2.plot: When Team Scorpion and Walter's parents visit Megan in the hospital as her health deteriorates, they are quarantined after a deadly fungus outbreak threatens to infect everyone.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E11 - The Old College Try
2.plot: Team Scorpion goes undercover at a university to find a hacker who infiltrates the Federal Reserve and threatens to collapse the world economy.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E12 - Dam Breakthrough
2.plot: Team Scorpion must stop a catastrophe on Christmas Eve when heavy rain creates a large crack in a dam, putting an entire town in danger.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E13 - White Out
2.plot: The members of Team Scorpion brave subzero temperatures in Antarctica to save a United States Special Forces unit. Toby risks his life to save Happy.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E14 - Sun of a Gun
2.plot: Sylvester comes face to face with his estranged father, a retired general, who asks Team Scorpion for help when he believes that a dictator in Africa has uncovered a deadly World War II-era weapon of mass destruction and intends to use it.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E15 - Da Bomb
2.plot: Team Scorpion is tasked with helping NASA’s top secret rocket launch, but they must sabotage their own mission when Walter’s date from the previous night has a bomb strapped to her chest.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E16 - Fractured
2.plot: After a powerful earthquake rocks Los Angeles, Team Scorpion must fix a pinched gas line to prevent a massive explosion.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E17 - Adaptation
2.plot: While Team Scorpion works to stop an influx of drugs being smuggled into the country via drones, Walter gives Happy and Toby an ultimatum on their new relationship.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E18 - The Fast & the Nerdiest
2.plot: After Sylvester scores big on The Price Is Right, Team Scorpion must infiltrate a high-end car smuggling operation about to ship bioweapons to South America.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E19 - Ticker
2.plot: When Los Angeles’ blood supply is hacked and deemed unusable because of fear it’s been tainted, Team Scorpion must find the culprit in order to save a young girl in desperate need of a heart transplant.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E20 - Djibouti Call
2.plot: While on a secret mission in Djibouti, Africa, with his new Homeland protégé, Tim Armstrong, Cabe is captured and Team Scorpion must save him.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E21 - Twist and Shout
2.plot: Team Scorpion’s mission to recover the remains of fallen Marines in Vietnam is threatened along with their lives when a deadly tornado heads directly towards them.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E22 - Hard Knox
2.plot: Team Scorpion is hired by the Department of Defense to break into Fort Knox and “steal” a precious artifact in order to test their security, but they must break in a second time when they find something dangerous hidden inside the object.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E23 - Chernobyl Intentions
2.plot: Team Scorpion goes to Chernobyl to repair the decaying nuclear reactor before a catastrophic meltdown, but must also save Sylvester and Paige when they become trapped inside.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E24 - Toby or Not Toby
2.plot: Team Scorpion must outthink their unstable ex-Scorpion member, Mark Collins, after he kidnaps Toby and threatens to kill him unless his cunning demands are met.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E03 - It Isn’t the Fall That Kills You
3.plot: When Walter is accidentally launched into space in a rocket, he hallucinates about Paige as his oxygen runs low, and Team Scorpion works feverishly to find a way to bring him home before he suffocates.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E04 - Little Boy Lost
3.plot: Team Scorpion must find a boy from Ralph’s class who goes missing on a field trip after he accidentally has a run-in with a deadly criminal. Also, Toby gets closer to finding out the identity of Happy’s husband.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E05 - Plight at the Museum
3.plot: Team Scorpion’s simple job at the Los Angeles Natural History Museum turns deadly when they discover thieves robbing a rare gem exhibit in order to get materials needed to enrich a nuclear bomb.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E06 - Bat Poop Crazy
3.plot: Before Halloween, Team Scorpion must infiltrate a deep, vast cave system in order to prevent a bat population from destroying the North America ecosystem. Also, the team dons costumes to stage photos from Halloween’s past for Walter’s upcoming immigration inspection.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E07 - We’re Gonna Need a Bigger Vote
3.plot: On Election Day, as democracy hangs in the balance, Team Scorpion is called on when someone tries to throw the U.S. presidential election into chaos.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E08 - Sly and the Family Stone
3.plot: When Team Scorpion travels to Ireland for Megan’s one-year memorial, Walter discovers that a nearby lake’s natural disaster has created a poisonous cloud that could kill everyone in the village. Also, Cabe and Toby try to alleviate the tension between Tim and Walter.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E09 - Mother Load
3.plot: Paige’s estranged mother calls on Team Scorpion when she accidentally uncovers a forgotten nuclear reactor on the verge of exploding.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E10 - This is the Pits
3.plot: Walter must swim through the deadly La Brea Tar Pits when Team Scorpion helps a woman trapped in the tar before she runs out of oxygen.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E11 - Wreck the Halls
3.plot: It’s Christmas Eve and Team Scorpion’s electronics-free mountain getaway turns deadly when they come across gun-runners, and Ralph is kidnapped when they try to escape.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E12 - Ice Ca-Cabes
3.plot: When a mission in the desert results in exploding shrapnel that seriously wounds Cabe, Team Scorpion must freeze his body in order to save his life.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E13 - Faux Money Maux Problems
3.plot: When Team Scorpion is duped into producing counterfeit money for a foreign entity intent on ruining the U.S. economy, Paige must rely on her mother Veronica’s skills as a grifter to save them.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E14 - The Hole Truth
3.plot: Team Scorpion must save a man teetering on the edge of a massive sink hole that threatens to destroy the Los Angeles water supply forever.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E15 - Sharknerdo
3.plot: Team Scorpion’s job to find sunken treasure goes awry when Walter and Paige’s boat explodes, leaving them lost in the middle of the Pacific Ocean surrounded by sharks.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E16 - Keep it in Check, Mate
3.plot: Walter and Sylvester enter an international chess competition under cover on foreign soil for Team Scorpion in order to extricate a U.S. spy before her identity is exposed.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E17 - Dirty Seeds, Done Dirt Cheap
3.plot: When a simple mission to protect a vital seed bank goes awry, Team Scorpion must save Happy, Sylvester and Cabe, who begin suffering from life-threatening, fear-based hallucinations.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E18 - Don't Burst My Bubble
3.plot: Following a severe storm, Happy’s friend Ada, who lives in a sterile bubble to protect her compromised immune system, is left with dangerous debris on the verge of puncturing the structure. Now, Team Scorpion works to safely move Ada to a more secure location without risking her life.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E19 - Monkey See, Monkey Poo
3.plot: To stop a dangerous virus from spreading, Team Scorpion must locate a rare endangered monkey in the Amazon that has the antibody for the cure. Also, Toby and Happy see a counselor to prepare for matrimony.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E20 - Broken Wind
3.plot: While on a mission to repair a turbine at a wind farm, Team Scorpion must race to save Paige and Happy before the cable holding the gondola they are in snaps and sends them plummeting to the ground.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E21 - Rock Block
3.plot: Team Scorpion must defy the orders of a foreign government after they retrieve an asteroid from space containing DNA strands that could have deadly consequences once exposed.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E22 - Strife on Mars
3.plot: Team Scorpion gets trapped inside a failing and dangerous biodome designed for Mars while trying to extract a pair of scientists inside.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E23 - Something Burrowed, Something Blew
3.plot: Team Scorpion help Toby and Happy race to the altar to say “I Do” after a simple job extinguishing a tunnel fire becomes catastrophic.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E24 - Maroon 8
3.plot: While en route to Toby and Happy’s honeymoon, Team Scorpion’s plane crash lands on a remote deserted island, leaving them all with little hope for rescue.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E25 - Scorp Family Robinson
3.plot: Three weeks after they crash land on a deserted island, tensions run high for Team Scorpion when they must battle to overcome their relationship obstacles with each other in order to be rescued.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E01 - Extinction
4.plot: Team Scorpion must work with their old nemesis Mark Collins in order to prevent the extinction of mankind. Also, Walter and Paige awkwardly navigate their new relationship.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E02 - More Extinction
4.plot: Team Scorpion continues to work with their nemesis, Mark Collins, in order to prevent an extinction event that could end humanity. Also, Cabe’s last-minute decision while on the case leads to the possible end of his career.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E03 - Grow a Deer, A Female Deer
4.plot: When poachers almost kill a pregnant endangered deer, Team Scorpion recreates the animal’s womb to try to save it and its baby’s life. Also, Happy and Toby discuss the future of their family.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E04 - Nuke Kids on the Block
4.plot: While decommissioning an old nuclear missile, a simple accident causes Team Scorpion to endure exposure to toxic vapor while trying to prevent the nuke from detonating. Also, Paige confronts Happy about constantly tagging along with her and Walter.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E05 - Sci Hard
4.plot: While attending a tech convention, Team Scorpion is taken hostage by a group attempting a virtual heist.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E06 - Queen Scary
4.plot: At Halloween, Team Scorpion takes on a case to prove the existence of ghosts on the Queen Mary but find an all-too-real disaster when they locate a “ghost ship” on a deadly collision course. Also, Walter considers taking note of Paige’s interests to benefit their relationship.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E07 - Go with the Flo(rence)
4.plot: While tracking a device that can prevent a nuclear meltdown through the Los Angeles sewers, Walter learns the nuances of listening and not offering advice to Paige. Also, Team Scorpion meets Florence, their new neighbor at the garage, after she sends a mix of smelly chemicals through their shared ventilation as a warning to keep the noise down.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E08 - Faire Is Foul
4.plot: For Sylvester’s birthday, Team Scorpion visits a renaissance festival, but the revelry is cut short when a group tries to rob a nearby police evidence locker. Also, Paige grows weary of Walter’s play-by-play of all the historical inaccuracies at the festival

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E09 - It's Raining Men (Of War)
4.plot: On Thanksgiving, Team Scorpion's new neighbor, Florence, joins them at sea on a mission to destroy a floating island of trash, but her flawed contribution leaves her, Walter and Happy stranded on the quickly dissolving island. Also, Toby works with Cabe to uncover the details of his father's death that he has suppressed since he was a boy.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E10 - Crime Every Mountain
4.plot: As Cabe’s trial looms over Team Scorpion, a simple case goes sideways when they help a father and his daughter whose plane crashes nearby. Also, Paige helps Walter navigate his feelings about Cabe’s possible future in prison.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E11 - Who Let the Dog Out ('Cause Now It's Stuck in a Cistern)
4.plot: As Team Scorpion anxiously awaits the verdict of Cabe’s trial which could send him to prison, they focus their nervous energy on trying to save a dog stuck in a cistern.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E12 - A Christmas Car-Roll
4.plot: On Christmas Eve, when Walter chooses work over spending quality time with his friends, he falls down the stairs and hits his head, and as he lays unconscious, he enters a dream world where Team Scorpion never existed.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E13 - The Bunker Games
4.plot: Team Scorpion must work with Toby’s nemesis, Quincy Berkstead, and his wife, Amy, Toby’s ex-fiancée, when they are locked inside an artificially intelligent doomsday bunker that aims to kill them. Also, Walter is distracted by his recent dream where he is married to Florence, not Paige.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E14 - Lighthouse of the Rising Sun
4.plot: A solar storm knocks out power in Los Angeles, and Team Scorpion must help a teen pilot and his girlfriend who are lost over the Pacific without navigation or radio contact. Also, during the crisis, Walter must look after a group of Ralph’s classmates, and Cabe tries to tell Allie finally that he loves her.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E15 - Wave Goodbye
4.plot: Team Scorpion must prevent an incoming tsunami from hitting a vulnerable nuclear power facility, and Toby secretly helps his ex-fiancée retrieve her stolen identity.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E16 - Nerd, Wind and Fire
4.plot: On Valentine's Day, Team Scorpion must set aside their romantic plans to help a doctor and pilot trapped inside a helicopter that crashed atop a skyscraper. Also, Toby and Happy wait for news on their fertility results, and Sylvester realizes that he may have feelings for Florence.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E17 - Dumbster Fire
4.plot: The geniuses of Team Scorpion turn into knuckleheads and Paige must simplify the science for them, when their mental faculties are impaired during a job to prevent the creation of a black hole. Also, Florence and Sylvester grow closer when she helps him with a special project.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E18 - Dork Day Afternoon
4.plot: Team Scorpion inadvertently crashes a bank robbery in progress and is taken hostage. Also, Sylvester’s feelings for Florence grow.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E19 - Gator Done
4.plot: Team Scorpion heads to the bayou to track down a cagey alligator in order to stop a deadly mosquito-borne virus, and Paige teaches Walter the concept of the “white lie.” Also, Walter hits Cabe with a tranquilizer gun and Toby must save his life, and Sylvester and Ralph help Patty when the mean girls at her school force her to get a dreaded tardy slip.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E20 - Foul Balls
4.plot: Team Scorpion must use their high IQs to win a softball game when the homeland director challenges, with all of their future government contracts on the line. Also, Walter’s secret night out with Florence puts Toby and Happy on edge.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E21 - Kenny and the Jet
4.plot: Paige’s maternal side goes into high gear when Team Scorpion must save an unconscious, hypothermic boy stuck in the wheel well of their airborne airplane. Also, Walter’s white lie to Paige starts to take a toll on him, and Paige realizes something’s up.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E22 - A Lie in the Sand
4.plot: Team Scorpion heads to Northeast Africa where they must carefully navigate a minefield in order to save the lives of local villagers. Also, Paige and Walter’s relationship takes a shocking turn, and Toby and Happy make an important decision.

meta.plot: Le ministère de l'Intérieur engage un génie et son équipe hétéroclite de prodiges pour protéger la nation d'une nouvelle génération sophistiquée de terroristes.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A British man crashes his car in Beijing and upon his return, he's accused of murder. After an incident on board, the officer escorting him begins to suspect foul play.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As Nolan fears for his life, tensions rise on board; Hana is instructed to investigate by the head of MI5 Delaney; Hana's sister starts digging into the events occurring on NCA 357.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Nolan recounts the events in Beijing; Hana continues to investigate the events on board; Jess's findings lead her to a mysterious international medical company.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Jess fears for her life when she becomes a target for both MI5 and a deadly assassin; Delaney uncovers a shocking truth that changes her understanding of events that night.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The truth about events on board is revealed, forcing Hana to take drastic action; Tennant is put in charge of Delaney's operation, forcing Delaney to break protocol.

meta.plot: Après avoir assisté à une conférence médicale à Pékin et avoir frôlé la mort dans un accident de voiture, le Dr Matthew Nolan rentre chez lui. Il est arrêté à l'aéroport londonien d'Heathrow. Épuisé et confus, Nolan est accusé du meurtre d'une femme qui se trouvait dans la voiture qu'il a accidentée.

1.title: FR - Dead Hot - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A first date with Will leaves Elliot floating—but also triggered. Jess receives a DNA match that changes everything. And when someone from Elliot's past shows up at work, there's no denying it—the horrors of 5 years ago are back to haunt them.

1.title: FR - Dead Hot - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Hoping to get more info on her DNA match, Jess visits the app's headquarters and meets someone who could have all the answers. Elliot continues his search for Will and discovers how deep the connections to Peter really go.

meta.plot: Liverpool, Elliot et Jess, deux jeunes vingtenaires, sont les meilleurs amis du monde, unis par le chagrin d'avoir perdu leur ami, Peter. Bientôt Elliot rencontre Will et Jess est contactée par quelqu'un qui prétend être son frère, ces individus vont bousculer leurs vies.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: British and French detectives are brought together when a body is discovered inside the Channel Tunnel.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: While the killer's second 'truth' unfolds, Stephen Beaumont crosses the paths of Karl and Elise once more.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The police face a race against time to identify and capture the killer as he steps up his campaign, targeting a further elderly victim in his 'moral' crusade.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Karl and Elise battle to locate an elderly soldier before he freezes to death at the hands of the killer. Meanwhile, runaway teen Sophie puts her trust in Benji.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The Truth Terrorist's third truth begins as Benji carries out his Samurai mission. The police hope to use teenage runaway Sophie to help trap the killer.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the killer's incendiary fourth truth begins, Karl and Elise's suspicions fall on Stephen Beaumont. A manhunt begins, but is he the correct suspect?

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Police think they may finally have a lead as the serial killer's actions escalate in his fifth and final 'truth', inciting mob violence in England and France.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: French police capture but then lose the prime suspect before Elise mysteriously disappears. As Karl searches Danny's flat, things start to fall into place.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: In the cross-Channel crime thriller's penultimate instalment, events take a nasty turn for Karl as police get within a hair's breadth of catching the killer.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The tense crime drama comes to an unmissable climax as Karl falls apart when the Truth Terrorist's change of direction becomes too much to bear.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Elise Wasserman and Karl Roebuck investigate when a couple are abducted from the Channel Tunnel in front of their young daughter. Events take a dramatic turn when a plane crashes into the Channel.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: The hunt for Madeleine becomes a matter of international urgency but Elise's investigation slows as she is forced to keep new evidence from Karl. Further links between the abduction and plane clash are discovered.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: As the investigation continues and terrorists plan a further attack in France, a man comes forward with links to Robert. Elise uncovers disturbing facts about Eryka's past and Karl follows a hunch.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Karl and Elise receive a tip-off from a woman they believe knows Robert Fournier's whereabouts. But can she be trusted?

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: An unexpected revelation threatens to turn Karl's life upside-down. Meanwhile, Eryka reaches out to Elise and Rosa offers the team a cryptic clue.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: An anonymous package gives Karl his biggest breakthrough in the case yet. Plus, the investigating team receive a clear and violent warning.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: The team are forced to strike a deal with Vanessa. Meanwhile, someone tries to warn Karl off the case and Elise crosses a line she may quickly come to regret.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: A lethal attack is launched and Elise and Karl's lives are thrown into jeopardy as the second series of the gripping crime drama ends in a nail-biting showdown.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: A burning fishing boat found on the Channel turns into a new case for Karl and Elise in the third and final chapter of the series.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: A shocking discovery is made at an immigration removal centre alongside a sinister animation containing a hidden message.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: The investigation steps up when Winnie is sent a live rat in a box, with a set of co-ordinates leading to the Pied Piper’s latest victim. Meanwhile, Karl’s disapproval turns to concern when he learns the extent of Elise’s distress over the Moreau case. In English and French

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: As a young mother-to-be helps Karl and Elise with their enquiries a new development threatens to tear the pair's partnership apart.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Karl makes a foreboding discovery at Elise’s apartment, and the pattern of missing people continues.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: In the final episode, Karl and Elise face a tense and gripping showdown with the Pied Piper, while the truth about the Moreau abduction is revealed at last.

meta.plot: Après la découverte d'un cadavre au milieu du tunnel sous la Manche, les polices française et britannique doivent mener une enquête conjointe.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Fresh off another unsuccessful date, Joanne sashays into a friend's party and meets Noah, an adorable rabbi who recently broke up with his girlfriend.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E02 - A Shiksa Walks Into a Temple
1.plot: Joanne and Noah get to know each other, but reality hits when she learns about his romantic history and he deals with an interrogation from his family.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E03 - Either Aura
1.plot: A podcast pile-on about her aura and an unanswered text make Joanne question if she's a good match for Noah, who faces a guilt trip after an accident.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E04 - Obliterated
1.plot: Joanne's last-minute dash to pick up a sex toy for a podcast episode makes for a memorable first date with Noah. Sasha helps Miriam with a boy problem.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E05 - My Friend Joanne
1.plot: Work obligations interfere with Noah and Joanne's plans to take their relationship to the next level, while Sasha and Morgan bond over family dynamics.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E06 - The Ick
1.plot: During an impromptu get-together with Joanne's family, Noah is determined to make a good impression — so determined that it's a major turnoff.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E07 - WAGS
1.plot: Meeting Joanne's friends? Easy enough for Noah. But winning over his pals means making nice with their wives and girlfriends, who are close to his ex.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E08 - Rebecca's Box
1.plot: Joanne's discovery of a small box in Noah's bedroom turns into something much bigger as she fights the urge to snoop, and he receives big news at work.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E09 - My Girl Bina
1.plot: Power games and a custom-made charcuterie board complicate Joanne's official introduction to Noah's parents. Morgan asks Sasha for a favor.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E10 - Bat Mitzvah Crashers
1.plot: Miriam's Big Apple-themed bat mitzvah sets the scene for even greater life changes when Noah and Joanne confront questions about their future.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E01 - Dinner Party
2.plot: Riding high on romance, Joanne and Noah merge their friend groups at a dinner party. But an offhand comment reveals they're not quite on the same page.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E02 - Leave It At The Tree
2.plot: When Joanne nudges Noah to express his feelings, he surprises even himself. Morgan's request for constructive feedback quickly devolves into blowback.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E03 - The Unethical Therapist
2.plot: An unlikely guest stirs things up on the podcast. Morgan's polarizing plus-one raises eyebrows at a party. Bina gets pushy with Sasha and Esther.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E04 - Valentine's Day
2.plot: When Noah cooks up a swoon-worthy Valentine's plan, Joanne worries about his true intentions — and the price of setting aside her own traditions.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E05 - Abby Loves Smoothies
2.plot: Intending to support Noah at a baby-naming ceremony, Joanne can't resist teaming up with Morgan for some payback against a former rival.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E06 - Anything Can Happen
2.plot: Still reeling from Noah's request for a "night off" from her, Joanne tries to keep it together as her parents meet his for the first time.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E07 - When You Know, You Know
2.plot: A blunder on an important shopping trip sets off fireworks on the podcast. Noah's modern new workplace delivers some old-fashioned culture shock.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E08 - A Better Rabbi
2.plot: Noah guides a surprisingly experienced new student. Joanne faces mounting pressure. Morgan recruits Sasha to dig up some digital dirt.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E09 - Crossroads
2.plot: An afternoon couples' hang goes off the rails when a provocative party game reveals everyone's most uncomfortable truths.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E10 - When Noah Met Joanne
2.plot: The complexities of love get all too real at a lavish celebration, as Joanne and Noah question what's worth holding onto — and what's slipping away.

meta.plot: Une podcasteuse sexo agnostique et un rabbin fraîchement célibataire tombent amoureux, mais leur relation peut-elle survivre à leurs vies opposées et à leurs familles indiscrètes ?

meta.plot: Pol Rubio commence à étudier la philosophie à l'Université de Barcelone tandis que la relation entre Bruno et lui commence à se renforcer. Pol va rencontrer de nouveaux amis, de nouveaux collègues et nouveaux enseignants, en plus d'avoir à faire face aux conflits dans sa nouvelle carrière comme étudiant, sa famille complexe et sa nouvelle relation avec Bruno jusqu'à devenir un maître de la philosophie.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E01 - Nice Face
1.plot: MI5 security officer Eve Polastri is bored in her job and yearns for a more exciting life. When a Russian politician is murdered, Eve is tasked with protecting the only witness and soon finds herself on a collision course with a violent and extraordinary assassin, Villanelle.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E02 - I'll Deal With Him Later
1.plot: In the aftermath of her recent assignment, Villanelle is ordered to take a break. Never one to do as she's told, she goes ahead with her next mission regardless. Meanwhile, Eve is given a dream opportunity to join a secret MI6 unit tracking Villanelle and the shady organization she works for.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E03 - Don't I Know You?
1.plot: When Villanelle kills a Chinese colonel at a kink clinic in Berlin, Eve and Bill travel out to investigate. While Eve and Bill chase up a number of promising leads, Villanelle enjoys the cat-and-mouse of their proximity. But as they draw closer, Eve comes to realize that this is much more than a game.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E04 - Sorry Baby
1.plot: Intel from Berlin points to the existence of a mole, prompting Eve to undertake her first surveillance operation. Meanwhile, Villanelle is sent to England to eliminate a member of British Intelligence. Villanelle wonders, could it be Eve?

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E05 - I Have a Thing About Bathrooms
1.plot: Having survived a terrifying close call with Villanelle, Eve now has the mole ensconced in a safe house and is buzzing. They have an exciting opportunity to glean information and crack this thing open.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E06 - Take Me to the Hole!
1.plot: A female assassin is taken into custody in Russia, and Eve and Carolyn head out to Moscow to negotiate access. She could hold the key to the organization that runs Villanelle. Meanwhile, Villanelle is smuggled into the same Russian jail. It's a grim and brutal place, where not even Villanelle is safe.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E07 - I Don't Want To Be Free
1.plot: Tensions are running high as the situation in Moscow escalates, and Eve starts to question who she can trust. Despite the danger, with her sights firmly set on Villanelle, Eve goes rogue. With both women under pressure, the stakes are higher than ever.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E08 - God, I'm Tired
1.plot: Villanelle's mission is proving anything but straightforward, forcing her to take drastic measures. Meanwhile, Eve makes a shocking discovery, which leads her right to Villanelle and an electrifying confrontation from which neither will emerge unscathed.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E01 - Do You Know How to Dispose of a Body?
2.plot: Eve is reeling from her act of violence against Villanelle and doesn't know whether she is alive or dead. A paranoid and severely injured Villanelle manages to get herself to the hospital for treatment. Carolyn approaches Eve with an intriguing opportunity.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E02 - Nice and Neat
2.plot: Carolyn introduces Eve to her new team before Eve briefs them on the Villanelle case. Villanelle, needing to lie low while she recovers, finds a good Samaritan to take her in and care for her.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E03 - The Hungry Caterpillar
2.plot: Villanelle's new circumstances are looking bleak, while Eve makes a dangerous deal with an old acquaintance. Villanelle is surprised when she is approached by a figure from her past.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E04 - Desperate Times
2.plot: Villanelle decides to take matters into her own hands on a trip to Amsterdam. Carolyn is called in to face the music with her boss. After the discovery of another dead body, Eve and her new team make a break in their case.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E05 - Smell Ya Later
2.plot: The MI6 team make a pact with the devil in order to get information from The Ghost. A visitor from Broadmoor comes with a dire warning, while Eve and Villanelle find themselves closer than ever.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E06 - I Hope You Like Missionary!
2.plot: The point of no return: Villanelle uses her unrivaled infiltration skills to immerse herself in the world of a new target. Their relationship on the rocks, Eve and Niko confront each other about their future.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E07 - Wide Awake
2.plot: Villanelle dives deep into the dangerous world of her target under the guise of her newfound persona, Billie. Eve may have worrying competition for Villanelle's affections.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E08 - You're Mine
2.plot: Eve's mission is disastrously compromised. Carolyn briefs Eve on her current status as an employee of the British government and leaves Eve's future in her own hands. Villanelle does everything she can in order to get to her ultimate target.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E01 - Slowly Slowly Catchy Monkey
3.plot: Eve attempts to rebuild her life, having been shot and left for dead in Rome by Villanelle. Villanelle, believing Eve to be dead, is approached by an old foe who offers her a new opportunity.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E02 - Management Sucks
3.plot: Eve strikes up an unlikely alliance with Kenny’s colleagues at the Bitter Pill, and Villanelle finds that management is not all it is cracked up to be.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E03 - Meetings Have Biscuits
3.plot: Villanelle agrees to a job that will take her back to London. Carolyn’s Moscow contacts come in useful when Eve and the team uncover a potential lead.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E04 - Still Got It
3.plot: Eve tries to patch things up with Niko, and Villanelle receives good news about her upcoming promotion.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E05 - Are You from Pinner?
3.plot: Villanelle returns home to Mother Russia to try to find her family. Perhaps a new connection to her roots will give her back what has been missing in her life.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E06 - End of Game
3.plot: Carolyn finds out that information is being withheld by those close to her, and Eve finds a lead which might bring her closer to Villanelle.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E07 - Beautiful Monster
3.plot: Eve finds a clue to Villanelle's whereabouts in the most unlikely of places, Villanelle and Dasha work together on a kill, and the pressure is getting to Konstantin.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E08 - Are You Leading or Am I?
3.plot: Konstantin makes a break for it, while Eve and Villanelle try to work out what the future may hold for them - together or apart.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E01 - Just Dunk Me
4.plot: Eve sets out for her revenge against The Twelve, even if it kills her. Villanelle tries to reform.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E02 - Don't Get Eaten
4.plot: Eve confronts Helene and seeks her aid against The Twelve. Villanelle's attempts to reform continue.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E03 - A Rainbow in Beige Boots
4.plot: Eve finds the name of Helene's target. Villanelle forces an MI6 psychiatrist to give her therapy.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E04 - It's Agony and I'm Ravenous
4.plot: Eve establishes her boundaries with Villanelle. Helene sets a challenge for Eve.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E05 - Don't Get Attached
4.plot: Eve seeks out any information about The Twelve's origin, but uncovers more than she bargained for.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E06 - Oh Goodie, I'm The Winner
4.plot: Eve nurses Villanelle back to health, then heads to Berlin to try to take her revenge on Lars.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E07 - Making Dead Things Look Nice
4.plot: Eve begins to question her identity and her actions, and she rekindles a relationship with Gunn.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E08 - Hello, Losers

meta.plot: Cantonnée à un travail de bureau bien peu passionnant, l'agent du MI5 Eve Polastri est frustrée par une existence bien monotone. Jusqu'au jour où elle se retrouve à traquer une tueuse psychopathe surnommée Villanelle...

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When the social security number of a young prosecutor comes up, Reese and Finch work together to figure out if their person of interest is the victim or perpetrator.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E02 - Ghosts
1.plot: Reese and Finch question the machine's reliability when they are asked to investigate a teenager who was killed years earlier; Finch remembers the origin of the machine.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E03 - Mission Creep
1.plot: Reese goes undercover to find the threat surrounding the next person on Finch's list: a young army veteran named Joey Durban.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E04 - Cura Te Ipsum
1.plot: Reese and Finch get some help from Detective Fusco  as they surveil their latest POI, Dr. Megan Tillman, while she’s on call and after hours to unravel the threat surrounding the promising young physician.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E05 - Judgement
1.plot: Reese and Finch have the added challenge of investigating a Person of Interest who wants nothing to do with their brand of vigilante justice.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E06 - The Fix
1.plot: Reese becomes romantically involved with the newest Person of Interest: an attractive woman who isn't all that she seems.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E07 - Witness
1.plot: The Machine identifies a school teacher who witnessed a mob hit as their next POI and Reese and Finch rush to save his life.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E08 - Foe
1.plot: When Reese and Finch discover that their latest POI has connections to Cold War Soviet espionage circles, they quickly learn how covert ops were handled in a world before The Machine.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E09 - Get Carter
1.plot: Reese and Finch’s game of cat and mouse with Detective Carter becomes infinitely more complicated when The Machine declares that she is their newest POI.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E10 - Number Crunch
1.plot: As Detective Carter deals with the fallout from her recent encounter with Reese and Finch, The Machine ups the ante for the duo by giving them four Social Security numbers instead of one.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E11 - Super
1.plot: Reese is confined to a wheelchair recovering from his gunshot wound, but Finch sets him up in an apartment where he’s to keep an eye on the Super, who is their latest POI. Also, Finch approaches Carter and gives her a POI to show her what they do.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E12 - Legacy
1.plot: When Carter finally comes face-to-face with Reese, he urges her to join forces to help with their latest POI, a scrappy young woman from the wrong side of the tracks who turned her life around and became a lawyer.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E13 - Root Cause
1.plot: The Machine gives Reese and Finch the number of a down-and-out man who has been pushed too far, and they're forced to turn to former Person of Interest, Zoe Morgan, for help.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E14 - Wolf and Cub
1.plot: The Machine identifies Darren, a teenager whose brother was just murdered, as the next POI. Meanwhile, Finch is growing concerned that the son of his former business partner is dangerously close to finding out about the Machine.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E15 - Blue Code
1.plot: Reese discovers there’s more to the story after he infiltrates a smuggling ring to get close to his latest POI.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E16 - Risk
1.plot: The Machine leads Reese and Finch to Wall Street when a sharp young trader at a major investment bank becomes embroiled in a multi-million dollar financial scam.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E17 - Baby Blue
1.plot: When The Machine spits out the number of a 6-month-old baby, Reese and Finch turn into overly protective parents – with an arsenal at their disposal. Meanwhile, when Elias resurfaces, Detective Carter begins to question her new allegiance with Reese and Finch

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E18 - Identity Crisis
1.plot: The Machine's latest number presents a unique challenge for Reese and Finch since the person has virtually no digital footprint - and appears to be leading a double life.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E19 - Flesh and Blood
1.plot: When The Machine spits out five numbers, naming the Don of each of New York’s crime families, Reese and Finch suspect Elias is planning to eliminate his competition.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E20 - Matsya Nyaya
1.plot: Reese goes undercover as an armored car company employee, and faces memories from his past with the CIA.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E21 - Many Happy Returns
1.plot: Finch gives Reese his birthday off so that his partner doesn't have to face a Number that is tied to Reese's past.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E22 - No Good Deed
1.plot: The newest POI’s curiosity could spell his doom when he finds himself embroiled in a dark government conspiracy – one that Finch is all too familiar with. Meanwhile, Reese uncovers something revealing about Finch’s past.

1.title: FR - Person of Interest - S01E23 - Firewall
1.plot: As the clock ticks down, Reese winds up trapped with his POI in the most heavily surveilled part of the city, forced to rely on the help of Finch, Carter and Fusco to fend off the FBI, corrupt cops and a slew of old foes.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E01 - The Contingency
2.plot: With Finch missing – kidnapped by his hacker nemesis, Root, Reese enlists Detectives Carter and Fusco to get his friend back, Meanwhile, The Machine never sleeps, disseminating a new number to Reese.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E02 - Bad Code
2.plot: The Machine delivers the number of a cold case that leads Reese ever closer to catching up with Finch and his kidnapper, Root.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E03 - Masquerade
2.plot: With Finch back in the Library, Reese returns to field work, only to face his toughest case yet – protecting the privileged daughter of a Brazilian diplomat.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E04 - Triggerman
2.plot: When The Machine gives them the number of a mob enforcer whose life becomes endangered, Reese and Finch must decide whether to intervene or allow karma to balance the scales of justice. Meanwhile, Finch seeks aid from an unlikely source.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E05 - Bury the Lede
2.plot: Reese must protect an investigative journalist through surreptitious means to avoid becoming part of her story.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E06 - The High Road
2.plot: Reese goes undercover in an idyllic neighborhood when The Machine’s latest number sends him to the suburbs.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E07 - Critical
2.plot: The Machine gives Finch and Reese the number of a brilliant surgeon, but they soon discover that a resourceful third party has raised the stakes for this POI, forcing them to turn to an unlikely source for help.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E08 - Til Death
2.plot: The team is spread thin when a husband and wife’s numbers both come up

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E09 - C.O.D.
2.plot: When the machine names a New York cabdriver as a person of interest, any of his passengers could be a part of the impending crime.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E10 - Shadow Box
2.plot: As the FBI pursues "the man in the suit," Reese is even more determined to protect the latest person of interest after learning she is the sister of a soldier who was killed in action.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E11 - 2πR
2.plot: Finch goes under cover to protect a youth who reminds him of himself; Carter goes on a dangerous mission for the FBI.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E12 - Prisoner's Dilemma
2.plot: Carter tries to help Reese by engaging in mental warfare with the FBI; Reese has encounters with old and new enemies; Detective Fusco must protect supermodel Karolina Kurkova, the latest person of interest.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E13 - Dead Reckoning
2.plot: Reese is abducted by a former acquaintance planning a massive and potentially deadly act of cyber-warfare.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E14 - One Percent
2.plot: Finch and Reese meet their match: a tech billionaire whose curiosity and endless resources could expose their identities and ruin their efforts to save his life.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E15 - Booked Solid
2.plot: As Reese and Finch try to save a hotel maid's life, they encounter a litany of suspects; Detective Carter considers a significant offer from the FBI.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E16 - Relevance
2.plot: A lethal government operative who tracks and stops terrorist threats before they occur finds herself on the run – and the new focus of Reese and Finch's attention. However, their pursuit proves to be their most formidable when they discover that her remarkable skill set equals their own.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E17 - Proteus
2.plot: As Finch and Reese try to protect six people simultaneously, clues lead them to a coastal town; when a storm forces Finch and Reese to seek shelter in a police station with a group of locals, they realize a killer may be in their midst.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E18 - All In
2.plot: Finch and Reese head to Atlantic City to protect the latest person of interest, an elderly gambler; Carter tries to clear another detective's name.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E19 - Trojan Horse
2.plot: Finch infiltrates a tech corporation to gather intel on an executive whose number has come up; Carter questions Beecher's integrity.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E20 - In Extremis
2.plot: When a person of interest is poisoned, Finch and Reese only have 24 hours to identify the toxin and find the person responsible; Detective Fusco's past catches up to him.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E21 - Zero Day
2.plot: When a virus causes the machine to malfunction, numbers are issued irregularly; the team searches for an extremely elusive tech millionaire.

2.title: FR - Person of Interest - S02E22 - God Mode
2.plot: Finch and Reese team up with unexpected allies as they race to fix the machine; as Detective Carter tries to apprehend Cal Beecher's murderer, she finds herself up against HR -- a criminal organization.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E01 - Liberty
3.plot: The Machine, now completely self-governed with its whereabouts unknown, resumes giving Finch its "irrelevant" numbers for people in danger, which include a U.S. naval officer in town for Fleet Week. However, with so many sailors flooding the streets of New York City, finding the officer in time presents an even bigger challenge for Reese and Shaw.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E02 - Nothing to Hide
3.plot: The number comes up for an Internet entrepreneur in the business of eliminating people's privacy, but finds his own being rapidly stripped away. As his life spirals out of control, Reese tries to protect him while Finch calls on Shaw, Carter and Fusco for help finding whoever is after him.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E03 - Lady Killer
3.plot: The team suspects the latest number to be a potential stalker/ killer. Root plots her escape from the institution and gives her psychiatrist a big surprise.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E04 - Reasonable Doubt
3.plot: The team must figure out if a prominent lawyer orchestrated the murder of her husband or if she is being framed; Carter is spotted with Reese by her new partner.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E05 - Razgovor
3.plot: Shaw must stay close to a 10-year-old girl with highly developed surveillance skills when she is identified by the machine; Carter's mission could be exposed.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E06 - Mors Praematura
3.plot: After being freed from her confinement to the psych ward, Root needs Shaw's help with a directive from the machine; Finch and Reese look into a mild-mannered investigator.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E07 - The Perfect Mark
3.plot: The team is met with surprises during an investigation into a hypnotherapist; an antiquities dealer has ties to a crime organization.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E08 - Endgame
3.plot: The machine gives Finch 38 numbers at once; information about Carter's past is revealed.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E09 - The Crossing
3.plot: The battle to bring a crime organization to justice reaches a new level; Reese's number comes up in the machine.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E10 - The Devil's Share
3.plot: As the POI team seeks justice for Carter’s murder, Finch realizes one of his team members may go one step too far in order to end the war with HR. Also, The Machine gives out the number for NYPD Officer Patrick Simmons, one of the crime organization’s key players.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E11 - Lethe
3.plot: Flashbacks to Finch’s adolescence provide insight into his creation of The Machine. Also, the team receives the number of an already dying man, and Reese leaves the POI team behind in the aftermath of the war with the crime organization, HR.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E12 - Aletheia
3.plot: Multiple enemies converge on the POI team as they protect a dying man whose number has come up. They struggle to keep their enemies at bay but without Reese, who has left them and their mission behind following the tragic war with HR, being down one man could have catastrophic repercussions for the team.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E13 - 4C
3.plot: Reese boards an international flight in an attempt to put the team and the past behind him, but is angered when he realizes his travel plans have been manipulated.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E14 - Provenance
3.plot: Reese rejoins Finch in New York, but when the team receives the number of a highly skilled antiquities thief, a surprising turn of events finds them planning a heist which could land them all in jail.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E15 - Last Call
3.plot: Finch goes undercover in an emergency call center to protect a 911 operator, but it soon becomes clear that the threat reaches further than the team could have anticipated.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E16 - RAM
3.plot: The secrets of Finch’s operation before he enlisted Reese are revealed, including shocking ties to present-day events.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E17 - /
3.plot: The Machine assigns Root to seek out a janitor with a mysterious past, but when her very presence puts his life in danger, Finch also receives his number.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E18 - Allegiance
3.plot: Finch and Reese must delve into the murky waters of international politics when they are given the number of a former government contractor who is stalking a UN diplomat. Also, an enemy attempts to gain an upper hand on Root.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E19 - Most Likely To...
3.plot: Reese and Shaw pose as alumni at a high school reunion in order to keep eyes on the latest POI. Meanwhile, Finch and Fusco travel to Washington, D.C., to investigate the motivations behind Vigilance’s latest attack.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E20 - Death Benefit
3.plot: Reese poses as a Secret Service agent to get close to the latest POI, a U.S. congressman who may hold the key to derailing Decima’s plans to bring a second Machine online.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E21 - Beta
3.plot: As Decima uses Samaritan’s feeds to hunt Reese and Shaw, Greer exploits Finch’s greatest weakness in an attempt to lure him out of hiding: his love for his former fiancée, Grace Hendricks.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E22 - A House Divided
3.plot: When an unknown entity prevents The Machine from seeing the full picture of an impending catastrophic event, it sends the team five separate numbers to help them piece together the bigger picture. Meanwhile, Root’s team of hackers arrives in New York.

3.title: FR - Person of Interest - S03E23 - Deus Ex Machina
3.plot: The team takes desperate action in its race to prevent the malevolent AI program Samaritan from coming online and making them its first targets. Meanwhile, the months-long battle with the anti-surveillance terrorist group Vigilance comes to a shocking conclusion.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E01 - Panopticon
4.plot: Forced to take on new identities provided by Root, the team members try to adapt to their new lives. However, some find it hard to ignore The Machine's numbers, which puts them all at risk of being detected by Samaritan.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E02 - Nautilus
4.plot: Despite not wanting to help with the new numbers, Finch's interest is piqued when the newest person of interest turns out to be a brilliant college student involved with a mysterious scavenger hunt.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E03 - Wingman
4.plot: Finch recruits Fusco to stick close to the latest POI, a professional 'wingman', but learning how to approach women soon becomes the least of his worries. Reese must find a way to play by the rules at his new day job. The Machine sends Finch and Root on a mysterious errand.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E04 - Brotherhood
4.plot: Reese's cover job as a detective at the NYPD becomes complicated when the young brother and sister he's protecting become targets of a gang investigation.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E05 - Prophets
4.plot: While Reese is forced to go to counseling for his violent tendencies, Root, Shaw and Finch try to help a new POI.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E06 - Pretenders
4.plot: Reese, Shaw and Fusco must protect a unassuming office worker who stumbles into a dangerous conspiracy while moonlighting as fake detective. Finch travels to Hong Kong as part of his academic cover identity.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E07 - Honor Among Thieves
4.plot: Shaw joins a team of international thieves in order to keep tabs on the latest POI, but an unexpected turn of events puts her in danger of being detected by Samaritan.  Also, Finch and Root undertake a dangerous sabotage mission.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E08 - Point of Origin
4.plot: Reese volunteers as an NYPD police academy instructor in order to keep an eye on a talented young officer whose suspicious actions make him question her motives. Meanwhile, Martine – armed with information from Samaritan – hunts a member of the team.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E09 - The Devil You Know
4.plot: Reese must save Elias from the Brotherhood. He can't get any help from Root or Shaw since Shaw's cover is blown and Root is escorting her to underground.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E10 - The Cold War
4.plot: Samaritan shows its power by erasing crime from the city for a day in an attempt to force The Machine out of hiding.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E11 - If-Then-Else
4.plot: Samaritan launches a cyber-attack on the stock exchange, forcing the team to risk their lives in a desperate mission to stop a global economic catastrophe.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E12 - Control-Alt-Delete
4.plot: Control, who oversees the handling of relevant numbers for the government, begins to question the methods and intentions of the Samaritan program. Also, alarming news reports of a pair of vigilantes rampaging through the Northeast begin to surface.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E13 - M.I.A.
4.plot: Root and Reese investigate a small town in upstate New York that holds the key to Shaw's location... and whether she's dead or alive.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E14 - Guilty
4.plot: When the Machine arranges for Finch to sit on the jury of a murder trial, he begins to suspect that a fellow juror is set to rig the proceedings. Meanwhile, Reese begins to open up to the department’s therapist.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E15 - Q&A
4.plot: Reese tries to protect a software programmer with a mysterious second life, but it’s unclear which side of her life the threat is coming from. Meanwhile, Claire, a young hacker whom Finch tried to protect from Samaritan, reaches out to him for aid.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E16 - Blunt
4.plot: Reese and Finch must protect Harper, a street-smart grifter, when her plan to steal cash from a medical marijuana dispensary goes up in smoke.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E17 - Karma
4.plot: Reese and Finch try to protect a psychologist whose unorthodox methods for helping his patients find closure could cost him dearly. Meanwhile, flashbacks reveal Finch’s fragile state in the days following the bombing that killed his best friend, Nathan Ingram.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E18 - Skip
4.plot: Reese must protect a bounty hunter who refuses to allow the potential threat to her life sway her from the relentless pursuit of her target. Also, Finch tries to set the plan he began in Shanghai in motion.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E19 - Search and Destroy
4.plot: Reese and Finch scramble to protect a software CEO when his behavior becomes increasingly erratic following a hacker attack that reveals all his secrets and unravels his life.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E20 - Terra Incognita
4.plot: Reese finds himself on a dangerous personal journey when he takes on a homicide case Detective Carter was never able to close.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E21 - Asylum
4.plot: Reese and Fusco get caught in the war between the two newest POIs, rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic. Also, a tantalizing clue to Shaw’s whereabouts leads Finch and Root into a possible trap, and Control goes rogue to uncover the true intentions of the Samaritan program.

4.title: FR - Person of Interest - S04E22 - YHWH
4.plot: Finch and Root race to save The Machine, which has been located by the rival AI, Samaritan. Also, Reese is caught in the middle of the final showdown between rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E01 - B.S.O.D.
5.plot: Reese and Finch attempt to rescue the Machine’s source code before it deteriorates beyond repair. Also, Root fights for her life against an onslaught of Samaritan’s agents and Fusco is faced with hard questions following the deaths of Dominic and Elias.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E02 - SNAFU
5.plot: The Machine experiences a glitch during rebooting, supplying Reese and Fusco with the numbers of dozens of people not actually involved in crimes, while also locking Finch and Root out after identifying them as threats based on past violent behavior.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E03 - Truth Be Told
5.plot: Reese’s cover could be blown when he realizes the latest POI has ties to his old CIA colleague, Kara Stanton.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E04 - 6,741
5.plot: Shaw escapes her captors, but the team is unsure of her mental state when she begins to act paranoid and reckless.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E05 - ShotSeeker
5.plot: Reese protects an NYPD analyst whose investigation into a software glitch has drawn the attention of Samaritan. Also, Reese and Fusco are threatened by an ally of Elias’s, who is looking to avenge his friend’s death.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E06 - A More Perfect Union
5.plot: The Machine sends Reese and Finch to a wedding to protect a pair of POIs before their nuptials. Also, Fusco becomes angry at being kept in the dark by the team and takes it upon himself to investigate a string of missing person reports.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E07 - QSO
5.plot: Root goes undercover at a radio station to protect the host of a conspiracy theory show who stumbles upon information that could get him killed. Also, Samaritan’s agents try to convince a member of the team that their goals are noble.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E08 - Reassortment
5.plot: Reese and Finch become trapped in a hospital that becomes ground zero for a deadly viral outbreak. Also, Samaritan’s newest recruit has second thoughts and Shaw continues to struggle with reality.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E09 - Sotto Voce
5.plot: The mysterious criminal mastermind known as “The Voice” returns and traps Reese and Fusco in their own precinct with several armed gang members and the latest POI. Also, Root makes a shocking discovery.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E10 - The Day the World Went Away
5.plot: Finch’s number comes up when a fatal error blows his cover identity and sets off a deadly series of escalating encounters with Samaritan’s operatives.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E11 - Synecdoche
5.plot: The team must unravel a conspiracy and stay ahead of the Secret Service when the President of the United States becomes their newest POI. Also, Finch separates himself from the team and considers taking drastic action to combat Samaritan.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E12 - .exe
5.plot: As Reese and Shaw race to catch up with Finch, he infiltrates a maximum-security government facility in a desperate mission which could mean the end for not only Samaritan, but for himself and The Machine as well.

5.title: FR - Person of Interest - S05E13 - return 0
5.plot: Finch, Reese, Fusco and Shaw embark on one last mission to prevent Samaritan from destroying The Machine and cementing its hold over mankind.

meta.plot: Un agent paramilitaire de la CIA, présumé mort, est recruté par un millionnaire reclu pour travailler sur un projet top-secret : prévenir le crime avant qu'il ne se produise ! Un ingénieux programme élaboré par Finch identifie chaque jour des personnes qui vont être impliquées dans un crime. Victime ou coupable ? Reese va devoir mener l'enquête pour découvrir qui est en danger et empêcher qu'un nouveau meurtre soit commis...

1.title: FR - Hijack - S01E04 - Not Responding

1.title: FR - Hijack - S01E05 - Less Than an Hour
