18.plot: Zak and the crew investigate dark energy at a Las Vegas gentlemen's club.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E03 - Lutes Casino
18.plot: The crew investigates a former casino with a shady past in Yuma, AZ.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E04 - Melrose Hotel
18.plot: The crew investigates a historic hotel plagued by dark spirits in Colorado.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E05 - Binion's Hotel and Casino
18.plot: The crew investigates two hotels inside an infamous Las Vegas casino.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E06 - The Woodbury
18.plot: The crew investigates aggressive spirit activity at a California estate.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E07 - Crescent Hotel
18.plot: The crew investigates a historic hotel plagued by restless spirits in Eureka Springs, AR. They capture a curtain moving on its own and make contact with Michael, the hotel's most active and notorious ghost.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E08 - St. Ignatius Hospital
18.plot: Zak and the crew stick together as they investigate a 127-year-old hospital in Colfax, WA. The building may be abandoned, but it's far from quiet with reports of visitors hearing strange growls and being attacked by unseen hands.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E09 - Mount Wilson Ranch
18.plot: Zak and the crew land outside of Pioche, Nevada, to investigate a mysterious ranch known for its concentration of supernatural energy and countless reports of extraterrestrial activity.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E10 - Panic in Amarillo
18.plot: Zak and the crew rush to a private home in Amarillo, TX, where a family is reaching its breaking point with an aggressive entity. It's the guys' most complex and challenging investigation yet as they search for the truth.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E11 - Union Hotel
18.plot: Zak and the crew travel to the Bay Area to investigate aggressive paranormal activity at a historic hotel that has endured the brutal California Gold Rush, a smallpox epidemic and a period as a seedy flophouse.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E12 - Idaho State Tuberculosis Hospital
18.plot: Zak and the crew investigate a former tuberculosis hospital in Gooding, Idaho, that's been converted into an inn. The owners and their staff have been terrorized by whispering voices, ghostly children and the spirit of an angry old man.

18.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S18E13 - A Haunting in Scottsdale
18.plot: Zak and the crew investigate an Arizona home sitting on land once occupied by a Native American tribe. The owner claims he's been affected by a dark, aggressive energy and believes an ancient entity is haunting his property.

19.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S19E01 - Curse of the Harrisville Farm House
19.plot: Zak and the crew travel to Rhode Island investigate the site of one of America's most-iconic paranormal cases -- the Perron family haunting. The 300-year-old farmhouse has stood the test of time, but so too has the dark entity that roams the property.

19.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S19E02 - Albion Castle
19.plot: Zak and the crew are in San Francisco investigating a mysterious castle built on top of sacred caverns said to be a haunted by a female apparition. The current owners claim to be plagued by paranormal activity in almost every corner of the property.

19.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S19E03 - Cerro Gordo Ghost Town
19.plot: Zak and the crew investigate a former mining town sitting atop a mountain.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E01 - Horror in Biggs
20.plot: The crew investigates a demonic entity terrorizing a small California town.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E02 - Franklin Castle
20.plot: Zak and the crew investigate the most-haunted residence in Ohio.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E03 - Union Brewery of Death
20.plot: The crew is back in Virginia City, NV, to investigate a haunted brewery.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E04 - Nightmare in Antelope
20.plot: Zak and the crew travel to the Antelope Valley in Sacramento, California, to confront a demonic entity that's tearing a family apart. Zak believes an exorcism may be the only way to save them from the dark and powerful forces plaguing their home.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E05 - Goodwin Home Invasion
20.plot: Aaron's father, Don, calls Zak and the crew to his Las Vegas home to investigate threatening paranormal activity. The terrifying apparition of a little girl and a dark, powerful presence a neighbor believes is a witch has left Don scared for his life.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E06 - Haunted Hollow Forest
20.plot: Zak and the crew investigate reports of a mysterious gray entity haunting an ancient plot of land in West Haven, Utah. They uncover compelling evidence that suggests the paranormal creature originated with a shaman's curse.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E07 - The Chinatown Poltergeist
20.plot: Zak and the crew investigate claims of poltergeist activity at a Las Vegas tiki bar. The staff believes a horrendous shooting on the property in 1995 may be responsible for recent sightings of moving objects, flying shadow figures and a ghost girl.

20.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S20E08 - Beneath the Bonanza
20.plot: A saloon in Virginia City, Nev., where staff are being violently attacked by an entity that inhabits the basement; a haunted artifact known as the Suicide Table may be responsible for the aggressive activity.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E01 - Ghost Train of Ely
21.plot: The crew investigates the dark history of the Nevada Northern Railway.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E02 - El Rancho Hotel
21.plot: The crew investigates a dark wave of energy at a historic New Mexico hotel.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E03 - Painted Lady Brothel
21.plot: The crew investigates a former brothel inhabited by a vicious entity.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E04 - The Comedy Store
21.plot: Zak and the crew stir up spirits at an iconic comedy club in LA.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E06 - Curse of Ranch Island
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew investigate rampant paranormal activity at a once blissful communal compound outside of Las Vegas, known as Ranch Island. When Bagans is overcome by a dark energy, the team fears he may be in danger from a spirit trapped on the property.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E07 - Disturbed in Wickenburg
21.plot: The crew returns to Vulture City, Arizona, to investigate after attendees of a paranormal conference were negatively affected by a dark energy in the once booming mining town. Zak Bagans learns that active mining on the site may have unleashed an ancient evil.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E08 - The Joshua Tree Inn
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew check into the desert motel where country-rock pioneer Gram Parsons died in 1973. With help from special guest investigator, singer and social media personality Loren Gray, the team is in for an especially emotional and terrifying night as they investigate the intelligent and sometimes malicious paranormal energy that permeates the property.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E09 - Mayhem in Millville
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew investigate a Utah home owned by a descendent of the prominent Jessop polygamist family. Tenants fear evil has taken up residence in the basement, putting the guys in serious danger.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E10 - Benson Grist Mill
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew travel to Utah to investigate a 150-year-old grist mill haunted by shadow figures, poltergeist activity and an angry male presence. The guys are overwhelmed by the property’s dark energy as they attempt to contact a dead girl named Alice.

21.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S21E11 - Lost Souls of the Berkeley
21.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew board a steam ferry from the 1800s to investigate escalating paranormal activity. The staff fears something dark has awakened on the historical vessel after lying dormant for months during the COVID-19 pandemic.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E01 - The Great Saltair Curse
22.plot: Zak and the crew investigate rumours of a cursed music venue on the banks of Utah's Great Salt Lake. The location has been plagued by disaster and death.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E02 - Terror at the Toy Shop
22.plot: Zak and the crew encounter some of the most incredible poltergeist activity they have ever experienced at a toy and costume shop in Hollywood, California.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E03 - Haunting In The Hills
22.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew investigate the Hollywood Hills home of model and television personality Holly Madison. She is experiencing disturbing paranormal activity, including demonic growls, and suspects that whatever haunts the property is preying on her fear.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E04 - Territorial Enterprise
22.plot: Zak Bagans and the team open a terrifying new chapter in Virginia City, Nevada, a haunted town that’s kept the crew coming back again and again. This time, they are focusing on two places in town, the Territory Enterprise Building and the Knights of Pythias building. Locals suspect the town’s connection to a secret society may have opened a portal to the netherworld.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E05 - Emergency in Elk Grove
22.plot: The crew is called to Elk Grove, California, to help a grieving woman who believes she is being terrorized by a demon and fears for her safety. The case takes an even more twisted turn when she reveals that the dark presence haunting her may be responsible for her father’s death.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E06 - Carbon County Chaos
22.plot: When the small town of Helper, Utah, is under siege by dark forces, the mayor calls on the Ghost Adventures crew for help. She suspects that recent renovations to two historic buildings may be behind the surge in paranormal activity.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E07 - Montecito Mansion of Mystery
22.plot: Zak Bagans senses a historic mansion with a tragic and mysterious past in Montecito, California, has called to him. When the crew attempts to re-create a séance in the home's majestic main hall, they capture some of their most compelling evidence to date.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E08 - Mountain Oaks Mayhem
22.plot: Zak Bagans and the Ghost Adventures team gather in La Crescenta, California, to investigate an abandoned home that has been infected with evil. The dark forces that dwell there tore a family apart, and anyone who dares step inside the house is left fearing for their life.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E09 - Pacific Grove Nightmare
22.plot: The Ghost Adventures team arrive in Pacific Grove, California, to investigate a doll shop overwhelmed by dark energy. Shelves of dolls and puppets appear to offer up disturbing clues as the search for evidence leaves the team drained and disoriented.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E10 - Whitmore Mansion
22.plot: Zak Bagans and the crew investigate a Utah mansion soaked in tragedy and bloodshed. Unexplained paranormal activity has the new owner desperate for answers, and the team is concerned that a portal to hell has unleashed a negative entity into the home.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E11 - Panic on Pine Street
22.plot: The team investigates poltergeist activity at a historic saloon in Paso Roble, California. The activity is so relentless that staff and guests don't feel safe on the premises. Zak Bagans suspects it may be the sole work of an entity called "The Old Hag."

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E12 - LA Police Station Invasion
22.plot: The crew is called to the Los Angeles Police Museum to confront a dark presence that has invaded the once-thriving precinct. Zak Bagans believes the disturbing activity is linked to the macabre artifacts from some of LA's most notorious crimes.

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E13 - Petrified in Pahrump
22.plot: The Ghost Adventures crew are called to a desolate Nevada town to investigate a winery allegedly built atop sacred burial grounds. Fatal accidents plague the property, and the terrified staff is stalked by an evil presence. Can Zak Bagans get to the bottom of the deadly curse?

22.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S22E14 - Steinbeck House Haunting
22.plot: Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley and Jay Wasley travel to Salinas, California, to investigate the birthplace of iconic author John Steinbeck. For decades, witnesses, including Steinbeck himself, have felt a dark presence in the home. Could a portal be drawing spirits to the property?

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E01 - Hotel Barclay
23.plot: Zak and the crew return to LA's Skid Row district to investigate a nearly abandoned building steeped in a dark, grisly history that rivals the Hotel Cecil; the guys have their hands full as both the dead and the living push back on the investigation.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E02 - Lockdown in Lancaster
23.plot: The crew pierces the seal on California's Mira Loma Detention Center; decades of death, violence and bloodshed have scarred this massive compound, painting a thick layer of doom on every square inch and delivering some of the most solid evidence yet.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E03 - Fear in Flagstaff
23.plot: Zak and the crew check in for a night of terror at a Flagstaff, Arizona, hotel where guests and staff have reported troubling paranormal experiences for decades. The chaotic spirits trapped within are wreaking havoc, and the GAC may be the only ones who can help.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E04 - Stow House Haunting
23.plot: Echoes of a past investigation come into focus as Zak and the crew investigate a stately California ranch steeped in tragedy. A dark energy has taken root on the land, and the team must unravel its haunting secrets to help the terrified caretakers.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E05 - Mentryville Ghost Town
23.plot: Zak and the crew venture to California's first oil boomtown to investigate countless reports of ghostly activity inside its buildings and glowing anomalies in the surrounding hills. Paranormal chaos ensues as the guys attempt to unravel the mystery of Mentryville.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E06 - Hotel San Carlos
23.plot: Zak and the crew peel back the glamorous façade of a Phoenix, Arizona, hotel to expose a darkness that's said to drive people mad. As they explore the vacant rooms and halls, the team encounters a demonic presence that could be responsible for countless deaths on the property.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E07 - King Gillette Ranch
23.plot: Zak and the crew visit King Gillette Ranch, a sprawling compound built on sacred land. Its dark history plus a brush with a religious cult has birthed violent spirit activity that drains the living of their energy, making this the GAC's heaviest investigation yet.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E08 - Abandoned in Elko
23.plot: The crew awaken hostile spirits in Nevada when they investigate the Commercial Hotel and Casino; the building's rough history of lawless cowboys, cutthroat gamblers and exploited women fuels a malevolent energy.

23.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S23E09 - Village of Lost Souls
23.plot: The crew investigates reports of vicious paranormal attacks at LA's Heritage Square Museum; as the team explores this collection of Victorian homes, they suspect a dark portal is responsible for shadow figure sightings and poltergeist activity.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E01 - Sutro Ghost Town
24.plot: Zak and the crew delve into the darkness that surrounds the historic and very haunted town of Sutro, Nevada. The team suspects an old mining tunnel is fueling the abandoned settlement's ominous aura as they uncover numerous deaths, disasters and mysterious fires.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E02 - Ghost Island
24.plot: Zak and the crew brave a brutal winter blizzard to confront an aggressive presence at an abandoned ranch located off the coast of Utah's Great Salt Lake. Unmarked graves and whispers of a curse throw a shadow over the investigation as the guys seek out the dark, unseeable force.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E03 - Scotty's Castle
24.plot: Zak and the crew trek through California's Death Valley to investigate a sprawling complex shrouded in mystery. The guys find themselves captivated by the desert villa's dark, powerful energy as they explore its flood- and fire-ravaged grounds. Who or what is feeding this ominous aura?

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E04 - Orcutt Ranch
24.plot: Zak and the crew suspect evil forces are afoot as they investigate a California estate haunted by rumors of secret rituals in the basement and a gruesome double homicide next door. The team treads on very dark grounds as they attempt to unravel the mystery.

24.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S24E05 - Nightmare in Northridge
24.plot: Zak and the crew don their spiritual armor to battle a dark, invasive energy in a California home. Fearing a demonic attachment, the team calls in an exorcist to help dissipate the evil cloud that overshadows the deeply religious family who lives there.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E01 - Skinwalker Invasion
25.plot: Zak and the crew tread upon sacred ground when they investigate reports of skinwalker sightings in the remote town of Torrey, Utah. Was the invasion triggered by the desecration of Native American artifacts, or has a past investigation come back to haunt the team? Zak and the crew also investigate the Chuckwagon Inn and General Store and find themselves caught in a battle between an ancient energy and the dark spirits that haunt the building.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E02 - Terror on 25th Street
25.plot: Zak and the crew head to historic Ogden, Utah, to explore two adjacent buildings that are overrun with dark spiritual activity. One of the buildings once housed a thriving brothel, and locals suspect its former madam is still running her business from the grave.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E03 - LA Hospital of Horror
25.plot: Zak and the crew gain unprecedented access to a historic Los Angeles hospital to expose a demonic energy that has trapped countless souls inside the massive facility. This malevolent presence is a force to be reckoned with as the team explores the abandoned halls.

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E04 - Hotel Congress
25.plot: Zak and the crew check in for a night of terror at an infamous Tucson, Arizona, hotel plagued by poltergeist activity and spirit possession. Could a brush with one of America's most violent gangsters be responsible for the darkness that inhabits the building?

25.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S25E05 - Belmont Ghost Town
25.plot: Zak and the crew trek through the Nevada desert to locate a former Wild West town haunted by a grave injustice. The guys are shaken when they discover that the Manson family camped out in the courthouse of the crumbling town.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E01 - Poltergeist House Curse
26.plot: Bagans and the crew dig deep into the mystery of the famed Poltergeist House, launching an unprecedented investigation inside the site of the classic horror film location to uncover the truth behind a rumored curse. Did real-life events converge with Poltergeist's fictional storyline to unlock a lethal, ancient darkness? After the team's lockdown leaves them with more questions than answers, Bagans believes a terrifying relic from the 1982 film could provide insight into the sinister energy that haunts the suburban California home.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E02 - The Houdini Seance
26.plot: One the 100th anniversary of Harry Houdini's midnight visit to the fabled Winchester Mystery House, Zak and a team of paranormal experts attempt to summon the legendary magician's spirit. Will escaping death's grip be Houdini's greatest trick?

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E03 - Glen Tavern Tragedy
26.plot: Zak and the crew return to the Glen Tavern Inn in Santa Paula, Calif., to help its staff find closure after the loss of a local medium; Korn singer Jonathan Davis assists as the team digs deeper into the dark mysteries of the former gambling house.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E04 - Abandoned at Whiskey Pete's
26.plot: Zak and the crew find themselves in an eerie Nevada desert town to investigate a recently shuttered casino haunted by the spirit of a notorious bootlegger. The air is thick with tension as the team and comedian Matt Rife confront the dark energy that lurks around every corner of the abandoned building.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E05 - Mystery of Rispin Mansion
26.plot: Zak and the crew gain unprecedented access to the cursed Rispin Mansion in Capitola, California. Sealed shut after a violent paranormal event in 2012, the abandoned home has become a vault of concentrated evil, waiting for an opportunity to explode.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E06 - Living Dead on La Brea
26.plot: Zak investigates a former girl's school in Hollywood, Calif., after a gardener discovers bones in a shallow grave; could the remains be connected to sightings of a ghostly girl? Or is something more malevolent at play.

26.title: FR - Ghost Adventures - S26E07 - Midnight at the Museum
26.plot: Unsettling paranormal events near an exhibit of serial killer Samuel Little prompt Zak to investigate his own Las Vegas museum; are the events connected to Little's recently acquired remains, and could the lockdown reveal clues to his murders?

meta.plot: L'enquêteur paranormal Zak Bagans et son équipe, Nick Groff, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley et Jay Wasley, recherchent des lieux hantés au niveau national et international. Au cours de leur enquête, Zak et son équipe se familiarisent avec la région, interrogent les habitants sur les lieux hantés et rencontrent les mauvais esprits qui hanteraient ces lieux.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Course Nº 1 Gochujang Butter Bibimbap
1.plot: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Course N° 2 Sous Vide Cuisine
1.plot: Held captive in harsh conditions, Ji-young prepares a feast to win her freedom — but even her talent can't save her when a crisis puts her life in peril.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Course N° 3 Haute Cuisine
1.plot: Ji-young becomes Yi Heon's new chief royal cook after impressing him with her French cuisine. But Kang Mok-ju, consumed by jealousy, plots against her.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Course N° 4 **** and Spinach Doenjang Soup
1.plot: A high-stakes royal cooking competition awaits Ji-young and her fate at court hangs in the balance. Later, a troubled Yi Heon drunkenly summons her.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Course N° 5 Snowflake Schnitzel
1.plot: After an intimate moment together, Yi Heon begins rejecting Ji-young's meals — but soon find their minds wandering toward each other amid the distance.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Course N° 6 Black Sesame Macaron
1.plot: When the Ming envoy demands a cooking contest, Ji-young rises to the challenge to represent Joseon — and win what Yi Heon has promised her.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Course N° 7 Dongnae Pajeon on a Rainy Day
1.plot: In order to gain an edge in the cooking competition, Ji-young sets out to create a unique pot. However, finding the right craftsman proves difficult.

1.title: FR - Bon Appétit, Your Majesty [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Course N° 8 Rice Wine Beef Bourguignon

FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Behind the facade of their anonymity, these twelve ordinary people bring with them their own histories. Lives that are as complex as the trial, full of fractured dreams, shameful secrets, hope, fears, personal trauma, and prejudice.

1.title: FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Detective Sam Chedid takes the stand as various pieces of evidence are introduced to the court, some of which raise questions about Nathan Spears' involvement.

1.title: FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The Crown calls Claire's best friend, Amita, to the stand. As the trial gets more complex, so too does the jury room dynamics, as their personal lives become increasingly entangled.

1.title: FR - The Twelve [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Kate Lawson's provocative artwork takes centre stage in the courtroom. The Crown raises questions around her artistic methods, as well as revealing a complicated mental health diagnosis.

meta.plot: L'histoire de 12 Australiens ordinaires sélectionnés comme jurés dans un procès pour meurtre aussi traumatisant que controversé, dans lequel une femme est accusée d'avoir tué sa nièce adolescente.

1.title: FR - The Au Pair [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When happily married and successful Zoe struggles with her father George and stepson Noah she hires au pair Sandrine - who has a hidden agenda - setting off a chain of events that puts Zoe in grave danger.

meta.plot: Zoe semble mener une vie idéale aux côtés de son mari Chris, qui insiste pour qu'elle prenne une jeune fille au pair pour l'aider à la maison. En effet, elle est plutôt occupée entre son travail de couturière, son père George, qui s'est installé à proximité de sa fille afin qu'elle veille sur lui, et la gestion du quotidien avec Amber et Noah, les enfants de Chris. Zoe finit par accepter et...

1.title: FR - Most Wanted: Julius Kivimäki - S01E01 - Hunted by the FBI
1.plot: The premiere episode introduces Julius Kivimäki, a Finnish teenager who, by the age of 14, had fallen into the world of cybercrime. This episode establishes his early involvement with a group of criminal hackers, detailing his role in mass data breaches and the use of "swatting" to terrorize his targets. It also delves into one of his most infamous acts: the distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack on the Sony PlayStation and Microsoft Xbox Live platforms, which left millions of gamers unable to play on Christmas day in 2014.

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire raconte l'histoire vraie d'un garçon désigné par le FBI comme l'un des hackers les plus dangereux au monde.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E01 - A Beating Heart...
1.plot: Dexter Morgan awakens from a ten-week coma.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E02 - Camera Shy
1.plot: Dexter tracks down a serial killer in NYC as Harrison spirals from guilt.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E03 - Backseat Driver
1.plot: Dexter must carefully balance attempts to help get him acclimated.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E04 - Call Me Red
1.plot: Dexter attends a mysterious gathering as Harrison struggles at work.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E05 - Murder Horny
1.plot: Harrison's fears escalate as Dexter pursues a dangerous connection.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E06 - Cats & Mouse
1.plot: As Dexter closes in on a murderer, Harrison faces a crisis of identity.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E07 - Course Correction
1.plot: Dexter learns unsettling information as Harrison contemplates his future.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E08 - The Kill Room Where It Happens
1.plot: Dexter redirects his attention as a way to step up as a father.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E09 - Touched by an Ángel
1.plot: Prater and Charley's revelation forces Dexter to go to extreme lengths.

1.title: FR - Dexter: Resurrection - S01E10 - And Justice for All...
1.plot: Dexter and Harrison face the consequences of their darkness.

meta.plot: Après avoir survécu à ses blessures, Dexter se retrouve à New York. Il tente de renouer une relation avec son fils mais des meurtres rituels ensanglantent Big Apple.

1.title: FR - The Veil [4K] - S01E01 - The Camp
1.plot: Imogen visits a refugee camp in the remote mountains on the Turkish and Syrian border. Amongst the chaos, she seeks out Adilah, who has been separated and detained from the rest of the refugees.

1.title: FR - The Veil [4K] - S01E02 - Crossing the Bridge
1.plot: Imogen and Adilah continue on their journey to Paris and face a threat in Istanbul. Meanwhile, the pressure mounts on the CIA and DGSE to determine the true identity of the "Djinn al Raqqa."

1.title: FR - The Veil [4K] - S01E03 - The Asset
1.plot: Imogen reunites Adilah with her daughter in Paris as truth and lies become further blurred.

1.title: FR - The Veil [4K] - S01E04 - Declassified
1.plot: Amidst the increased threat on her daughter's life, Adilah reveals a secret to Imogen. Max must deal with the consequences of Emir's arrival in Paris.

1.title: FR - The Veil [4K] - S01E05 - Grandfather's House
1.plot: As the jigsaw puzzle becomes clearer to Imogen, she takes matters into her own hands. Max resorts to drastic measures whilst Emir puts pressure on Adilah.

1.title: FR - The Veil [4K] - S01E06 - The Cottage
1.plot: Imogen smuggles Adilah to England to see Michael, in the hope that answers will finally be given. Max and Malik must work together and follow as her only back up.

meta.plot: Deux femmes jouent un jeu mortel de vérité et de mensonges sur la route d'Istanbul à Paris et Londres. L'une des femmes a un secret, et l'autre a pour mission de le révéler avant que des milliers de vies ne soient perdues.

1.title: FR - Les Baldwin - S01E01 - Along Came Hilaria
1.plot: Actor Alec Baldwin and wife Hilaria celebrate oldest son Rafael's birthday. They pack up their seven kids and pets and leave for East Hampton for the summer, but with Alec's trial coming up, they face difficult decisions as a family.

1.title: FR - Pour le meilleur et à l'aveugle - S01E01 - Opening the Pods
1.plot: Teddy Riner and Luthna Plocus welcome French singles to the experiment. As dating begins in the pods, one couple's strong connection leads to a proposal.

1.title: FR - Pour le meilleur et à l'aveugle - S01E02 - It's Her or Me
1.plot: A case of mistaken identity makes for an awkward pod date. Bonds deepen between participants but for some their hearts are pulled in multiple directions.

1.title: FR - Pour le meilleur et à l'aveugle - S01E03 - Betrayals
1.plot: A shock announcement causes more upset for one participant, leading her to pursue a third connection. Could too much honesty put another match at risk?

1.title: FR - Pour le meilleur et à l'aveugle - S01E04 - Height Differences
1.plot: Tough decisions spark joy and heartbreak before the engaged couples jet off to sun-soaked Morocco, where they put their physical connection to the test.

1.title: FR - One Trillion Dollars - S01E01 - The Inheritance
1.plot: Bicycle courier John Fontanelli suddenly finds himself the heir of a trillion-dollar fortune. While the Vacchi family prepares him for what is to come, he is faced with a deadly trap set by ominous opponents.

1.title: FR - One Trillion Dollars - S01E02 - The Prophecy
1.plot: John barely manages to thwart a deadly attack. Although he fears for his life, he accepts the inheritance, encouraged by Franca. When the press gets wind of this, the immense pressure causes John to seek refuge in his newly attained wealth.

1.title: FR - One Trillion Dollars - S01E03 - Hope
1.plot: John and Franca launch Fontanelli Enterprises. Under the direction of Malcolm McCaine, the company buys up shares of global corporations in order to influence their exchange rates. But their success irritates a secret financial elite.

1.title: FR - One Trillion Dollars - S01E04 - Rabbit Hole
1.plot: John holds billionaire Morten Hellstroem responsible for the attack on Lino. Franca can't stop him from starting a personal vendetta. He decides to buy up Hellstroem's company in order to bring him down.

1.title: FR - One Trillion Dollars - S01E05 - The Conspiracy
1.plot: While Franca is set on positively influencing the exchange rates of global corporations through strategic investments, John tries to uncover the secrets of the financial elite. He goes to Algeria in order to expose the identity of its mastermind.

1.title: FR - One Trillion Dollars - S01E06 - The End of the World
1.plot: The entire financial market is in danger of collapsing, leading to world-wide turmoil. John now understands what the prophecy means - it is up to him to prevent this financial meltdown and save the world from certain doom.

meta.plot: Coursier à vélo berlinois de 25 ans, complètement irresponsable, John Pohlmann hérite de mille milliards de dollars et devient du jour au lendemain John Fontanelli, l'homme le plus riche du monde. Cependant, la fortune est liée à une prophétie qui prédit que l'héritier utilisera l'argent pour restaurer l'avenir perdu de l'humanité. Le glamour du luxe et du gaspillage s'estompe rapidement lorsque John réalise que son nouveau style de vie jet-set n'offre rien de substantiel. Poussé par une révélation, il entreprend de réaliser la prophétie. Au fur et à mesure qu'il s'engage dans ce combat, il se rend compte que des ennemis dangereux et puissants tentent de l'arrêter, menaçant de détruire non seulement John, mais aussi le monde tel que nous le connaissons.

1.title: FR - Mystery Road : Les Origines  - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Young police constable Jay Swan starts a new job in an outback mining town, where he spent his youth. Whilst investigating a series of robberies and pursuing the truth behind a personal tragedy, he meets the love of his life.

1.title: FR - Mystery Road : Les Origines  - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: After a bizarre robbery, Jay leads a visit to a local gang that quickly escalates. Anousha seeks clues about Josh Allen's death, and after the town's celebrations at the annual debutante ball Jay's night takes a tragic turn.

1.title: FR - Mystery Road : Les Origines  - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Jay struggles with findings about Jack's death. He looks for clues pointing to foul play and he fights with Geraldine about how best to commemorate his father. Anousha searches for people involved with Josh's case.

1.title: FR - Mystery Road : Les Origines  - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Jay discovers Jack was deeply in debt and when Sputty also seems to be involved he becomes suspicious. Jay and Mary grow closer, Anousha acts for Ziggy and the Kelly Gang unexpectedly strikes again.

1.title: FR - Mystery Road : Les Origines  - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After another heist by the Kelly Gang, Jay pieces together their identities and uncovers their hideout. Anousha finds an unexpected detail of the police investigation into Josh's death and suddenly finds herself in danger.

1.title: FR - Mystery Road : Les Origines  - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The Kelly Gang's plans violently come to a head in a shootout at the Roadhouse. Mary gets too close to Josh's killers and Jay finds out who was really behind his father's death.

meta.plot: Au cœur de l’Outback australien, le jeune inspecteur Jay Swan mène sa première enquête. Ce préquel de la série Mystery Road, offre un passé et une famille au flic aborigène taiseux dans un pays rongé par son passé colonial.

1.title: FR - Haunted Hotel - S01E04 - How to Train Your Demon

1.title: FR - Haunted Hotel - S01E05 - Rollyfluffs

1.title: FR - Haunted Hotel - S01E06 - Ghost Hunters!
1.plot: A ghost-hunting reality show films an episode at the Undervale. Ben opens up to an enchanted diary and shares all his relationship drama.

1.title: FR - Haunted Hotel - S01E07 - Seven Deadly Bens

1.title: FR - Haunted Hotel - S01E08 - Aunt Rose
