1.title: FR - Shetland - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Elderly Shetlander Mima Wilson is found murdered on the archaeological site in the grounds of her croft. Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez and his team investigate. Can Perez unravel the family feuds and secrets that emerge and restore the security of his beloved Shetland Islands?

1.title: FR - Shetland - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: With two murders and no strong leads, can Detective Inspector Perez and his team apprehend the suspect before crowds descend on the Shetland Islands for Up Helly Aa, the biggest fire festival in Europe?

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E01 - Raven Black - Part 1
2.plot: Old  wounds are painfully reopened for the shocked residents of Ravenswick,  as Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez and his team look to a past crime to  solve the present day murder of a young teenage girl.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E02 - Raven Black - Part 2
2.plot: Detective  Inspector Jimmy Perez believes he and his team are finally closing in  on the killer as they discover what 17-year-old Catherine Ross was  hiding from everyone in the hours before her death.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E03 - Dead Water - Part 1
2.plot: When an old acquaintance of Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez dies in a suspicious car accident on the island, he wonders whether his journalist friend had uncovered a story that cost him his life.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E04 - Dead Water - Part 2
2.plot: After a second body is found brutally murdered on Shetland, Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez wonders if the two killings are connected to corporate greed and corruption on the island or to just one woman - Evie Watt.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E05 - Blue Lightning - Part 1
2.plot: Perez returns to his childhood home after the murder of a scientist on the beautiful island of Fair Isle. Tensions run high as a storm on the mainland forces Perez to work in isolation - and compels all of the suspects to remain together under one roof.

2.title: FR - Shetland - S02E06 - Blue Lightning - Part 2
2.plot: Time is running out for Detective Inspector Perez as prime suspect Peter Latimer lies critically ill in hospital. Was the fire a drunken accident, or was Peter Latimer the second victim of a murderer still free on Fair Isle?

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: When a young man disappears on the Aberdeen to Shetland ferry crossing and a small boy ends up in intensive care, DI Jimmy Perez and his team investigate, becoming convinced the two events are connected.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: DI Jimmy Perez is convinced that Michael Maguire is somehow implicated in the death of Robbie Morton. But with the investigation seemingly under threat before it's even started, he faces an uphill battle to uncover the truth behind Maguire's silence.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: The murder investigation takes Perez and Tosh to Glasgow as they try to uncover the reasons behind Maguire's brutal death and his connection to Robbie Morton. But old ghosts return to haunt Perez as his enemies try to prevent him from getting to the truth.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Perez and his team are determined to track down the person who helped Michael Thompson's killer on Shetland. But the closer the team get to the truth in both Shetland and Glasgow, the more dangerous it becomes for all of them.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Perez struggles to deal with what has happened to Tosh as he continues to investigate the murders of Robbie Morton and Michael Thompson, but a shocking discovery finally leads him to the identity of who Thompson was going to testify against.

3.title: FR - Shetland - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: As the investigation reaches its final stages, Detective Inspector Perez and his team discover the person responsible for the deaths of Robbie Morton and Michael Thompson is closer to home than any of them thought.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E01 - Episode 1
4.plot: When Thomas Malone has his murder conviction overturned after 23 years behind bars, DI Perez has to reopen the investigation into the 1994 death of local teenager Lizzie Kilmuir.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E02 - Episode 2
4.plot: Perez is on the trail of an attacker, Tosh investigates an oil company in the hunt for Sally's killer, and DNA testing in the Kilmuir case yields a surprising result.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: Jimmy questions Donna about the shocking DNA results, Alison arrives in Norway in search of Andreas Hagan, and an unexpected twist leads Perez and Tosh into the murky world of the Norwegian far right.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Ignoring Secret Service warnings, Perez and Tosh track down Mathias Soderland. Back on Shetland, a beach memorial service is held for Sally McColl.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E05 - Episode 5
4.plot: Perez must re-assess the investigation in the aftermath of the attack. The MIT arrives on Shetland and sets its sights on Malone. Meanwhile, Tosh begins to have doubts about Lars.

4.title: FR - Shetland - S04E06 - Episode 6
4.plot: Season Finale - Troubled by historical DNA evidence results, Jimmy has to face the fact that Duncan may have been involved in Lizzie Kilmuir's murder, and potentially Sally McColl's as well. A shocked Duncan is brought to the station for questioning, hurt that Perez would even think him capable of murder. However, the detective knows Duncan's lying - perhaps not about the murder, but about something else significant. So when Duncan finally admits he had an affair with Donna, it's not long before a bombshell is dropped.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: A severed hand washes up on a Shetland beach, with further body parts discovered in a holdall that has been dumped at sea. Perez and the team begin a complex murder investigation.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E02 - Episode 2
5.plot: A horrifying discovery at the Hayes house changes the course of the investigation. Perez establishes the probable cause for Daniel's murder and his sister Zezi's disappearance.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E03 - Episode 3
5.plot: Sandy feels the heat in the aftermath of Calum’s suicide. Convinced that McGuire is the key to cracking the case, Perez travels to Glasgow in an attempt to track him down.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E04 - Episode 4
5.plot: Sure that Zezi is being held on Shetland, Perez and the team ramp up the pressure on their remaining leads. Personally, Perez finds himself in turmoil after his kiss with Alice.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E05 - Episode 5
5.plot: The discovery of Niki’s body intensifies the search for Zezi. Perez feels that time is running out. A desperate Olivia tries to get information from Jamie Hayes.

5.title: FR - Shetland - S05E06 - Episode 6
5.plot: Perez closes in on Zezi's location at last. But can he reach her before it's too late?

6.title: FR - Shetland - S06E01 - Episode 1
6.plot: When a prominent and controversial Shetlander is shot dead on their doorstep in broad daylight, Perez rushes back from his mother’s funeral to lead the investigation.

6.title: FR - Shetland - S06E02 - Episode 2
6.plot: In the aftermath of the diving incident, the team searches for a link between the two bodies. Meanwhile, Perez must deal with the return of Donna Killick.

6.title: FR - Shetland - S06E03 - Episode 3
6.plot: The hunt is on for Sandy's attacker, before a shocking confession causes tensions to boil over and some Islanders take justice into their own hands.

6.title: FR - Shetland - S06E04 - Episode 4
6.plot: After the shocking events of the previous night, Perez must piece together what happened before a rampaging and vengeful Creggan finds his target.

6.title: FR - Shetland - S06E05 - Episode 5
6.plot: Facing a dead end in the hunt for Galbraith’s killer, Tosh leads Perez to the remote island of Fetlar. Donna asks Duncan for one last favour.

7.title: FR - Shetland - S07E01 - Episode 1
7.plot: DI Perez investigates the disappearance of a vulnerable young man, whose family are new to Shetland. Has whatever they are running from come back to haunt them?

7.title: FR - Shetland - S07E02 - Episode 2
7.plot: After the discovery of an unknown body, the search for Connor grows increasingly desperate. Perez follows Danny on a perilous journey into his murky past.

7.title: FR - Shetland - S07E03 - Episode 3

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E03 - The fine print at the bottom of the contract
1.plot: A dive into the past: childhood, the family home, parents. And above all, friendship. At the age of 12, Denise decides to confide the secret of her superpower to her two best friends, Angel and Melanie... Then comes adolescence, a time of parties and excess; Denise enjoys her superpower without any remorse. It was during this period, while filming her first movie, that Melanie became Joy... Years later, when the friendship between the three had faded, Denise returned to her childhood home with Jérém, her great love. The time had come to reveal her secret to him...

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E04 - View of the mind
1.plot: Angel refuses to lend Denise money for Jacques' nursing home, but suggests organizing a poker game at Joy's house, just like in the old days. Denise finally agrees and, for one evening, becomes the legend of underground games once again, uncompromising and undefeated. But things get complicated when Jérém bursts into the apartment, throwing a spanner in the works of their carefully laid plans... Denise finds comfort in Sybil, a client who has recently started consulting her and to whom she feels increasingly close. For Sybil has a rare quality: she always says what she thinks, and always thinks what she says...

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E05 - We are born, we live, we die
1.plot: Sybil—now a close friend—gives Denise an ultimatum: she tells her to meet her outside on the street. The time approaches and Denise becomes increasingly nervous about going out. To encourage her, Joy enlists the help of the apartment community. To convince Denise to take control of her life despite setbacks, scars, and fears, each person reveals a key moment in their life.

1.title: FR - Extra-Lucide - S01E06 - Like you
1.plot: Joy decides to sell her wardrobe to put her past as a porn star behind her. Very quickly, a joyful and colorful crowd invades the apartment, much to Denise's dismay. What was supposed to be a simple clothing sale turns into an impromptu party. Joy, Angel, Sybil, Jérém, Jacques, Kevin, Nazim, Mikaela, Joy's friends, strangers passing through—all these voices jostle for space in Denise's head. What if, somewhere in the midst of this chaos, she finally finds the answers she has been searching for?

meta.plot:
Denise sait exactement ce que vous pensez. Et pour cause, Denise est télépathe. Elle connaît vos secrets les plus inavouables. Un super-pouvoir devenu peu à peu un super fardeau. Depuis un an, Denise vit recluse, loin des pensées du monde. Elle s’est réfugiée chez Joy, sa meilleure amie, gloire déchue du porno. Deux super-héroïnes sans trop d’illusions.

Et au final une question : peut-on être lucide et heureux en même temps ?

1.plot: Cassie's mischievous cousin Abigail returns to Middleton, forcing Cassie to attempt tough love as Sam and Grace are swept up in Abigail's spell.

1.plot: Cassie's magic can't keep her away from Abigail's scheming when the truth becomes too hard to hide and Abigail continues to stir the pot in Middleton.

1.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S01E06 - The Storm
1.plot: Cassie tries to convince Sam to follow her intuition in order to help a young couple survive a blizzard.

1.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S01E07 - Together We Stand...
1.plot: A storm continues to threaten the lives of the people in Middleton and Cassie and Sam work together to help.

1.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S01E08 - True Colors
1.plot: Cassie receives devastating news regarding the future of Bell, Book and Candle; the whole town comes together.

2.plot: Cassie and Sam decide to take a step forward, but his pushy ex-wife stalls them at the starting gate. Grace preps for the teenage rite of passage -- her driving test.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E02 - Driven
2.plot: The arrival of a man from Cassie's past may complicate her burgeoning relationship with Sam, but that isn't the only bump in the road - Sam's intrusive ex-wife Linda is still trying to keep Cassie out of the picture in a desperate attempt to repair their fractured family.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E03 - Out of the Past
2.plot: As Cassie's old friend John attempts to unearth their shared college memories, the Good Witch receives another visitor from her past when Ryan returns to Middleton seeking closure.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E04 - The Trouble with Love
2.plot: Cassie can't help but feel upset after Grace admits she's been spending more time with Sam to replace the hurt she feels from the loss of her own late father.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E05 - Surprise Me
2.plot: Cassie is surprised with adventurous outings by both Sam and John as she works on sorting out her conflicted feelings.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E06 - Risk
2.plot: Cassie could be ready to take a chance on her feelings for Sam. Grace goes on a magical mission to fix a broken confidence.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E07 - What's Your Secret?
2.plot: Cassie decides to host a surprise party for Martha, but after she enlists the help of Stephanie and Abigail, she finds out her secret might not be kept.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E08 - Truth
2.plot: Cassie attempts to work her magic to help Sam make a difficult decision and is suddenly faced with a difficult choice of her own.

2.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S02E09 - A Perfect Match Pt. 1
2.plot: Just as Cassie begins to move in a new direction with Sam, Middleton’s annual Lights Festival brings illuminating changes.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E01 - A Budding Romance
3.plot: The whole town anxiously awaits the impending blooming of the Middleton Merriwick, but when the plant is cut, it has dramatic impact upon the Merriwick women. Grace begins to suspect Nick is going to ask her out.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E02 - Without Magic for a Spell
3.plot: The Middleton Merriwick is still not in bloom, and the effects are being felt around town. An old friend and colleague of Abigail’s checks into Grey House claiming to want a relationship. With help from Cassie, Ben stumbles upon the old Middleton Theater and is motivated to get the place running again.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E03 - Day After Day
3.plot: Two guests at Grey House are immediately at odds, so Cassie uses her magic to bring them together. Sam tries to plan the perfect date for Cassie, but various nuisances keep getting in the way.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E04 - How to Say 'I Love You!'
3.plot: Cassie helps Ben find an old romantic film to showcase at the refurbished Middleton Theater's opening night. Martha's promises to the town are in jeopardy when she overextends herself with the Middleton budget.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E05 - A Birthday Wish
3.plot: A visiting chef can't relax, so she follows Cassie's advice and spends a day stirring a recipe in order to quiet her mind. Grace is presented with the Merriwick Wish Book for her birthday and is encouraged to make an entry.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E06 - Say It With Candy
3.plot: Abigail, jealous of all the attention Cassie gets from helping her customers, decides to sell “special” Venezuelan chocolates at her flower shop.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E07 - In Sickness and in Health
3.plot: Cassie gives a withdrawn traveling artist a new paintbrush and invites him to stay at Grey House, then she arranges for her and Sam to organize the Tri-Cities Healthfest, something that Cassie usually does by herself.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E08 - Somewhat Surprising
3.plot: Cassie decides to plan a surprise party for Sam to celebrate the anniversary of his move to Middleton.

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E09 - Not Getting Married Today, Part 1
3.plot: Sam's sister shows up for an unexpected visit and he is very happy to see her, though she does not seem like herself…

3.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S03E10 - Not Getting Married Today, Part 2
3.plot: After learning that Sam doesn't plan on getting married again, Cassie goes to Chicago to clear her head. Michael and Vanessa get fed up with their mothers while planning the wedding.

FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E01 - With This Ring
4.plot: Cassie gives those around her pieces of jewelry that magically turn out to be just the thing each needed. Abigail helps Sam search for the perfect engagement ring for Cassie -- a legendary Merriwick heirloom thought to be lost forever.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E02 - In 4/4, With Emotion
4.plot: An unpublished song written by a past guest at Grey House magically spreads throughout the town, hightening the emotions of those who hear it. Affecting each in a different way, Cassie and Sam learn to communicate about their future together.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E03 - Daddy's Home
4.plot: Abigail’s father comes to Middleton in hopes of making amends. Cassie helps an expecting couple accept how different their lives, and family, will be once the baby comes. Grace is forced to think about her future and what path she'll follow as she realizes her affinity for math might not be a passion.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E04 - Family Time
4.plot: Cassie, Sam, Nick and Grace “play house” as they spend a night away at the family lake house. Hoping to bring everyone together, Cassie faces a few obstacles before they start acting like a family again.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E05 - Written Like a Merriwick
4.plot: Grace finds herself under the spell of Elizabeth Merriwick after Cassie discovers an old trunk filled with her vintage clothing. Inspired by its history, and tapping into her Merriwick heritage, Grace finds a passion for storytelling. Meanwhile, Cassie helps a mother and daughter reconnect over their past at Grey House.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E06 - Match Game
4.plot: A secretive dating app developer on the verge of a breakthrough checks in at Grey House, capturing the entire town's interest-- especially Abigail's. Cassie and Sam play detective matchmaker to ensure a perfect couple used for app research find each other.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E07 - Til Death Do Us Part
4.plot: Cassie has to confront what "'til death do us part" means for her relationship as Sam travels to South America as additional medical aid during a tragic time. Grace digs up some of Middleton's earliest history while revising the town's website, and Abigial shares the same history with her budding romance, Phil.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E08 - All Dressed Up
4.plot: Cassie sets out to track down Elizibeth Merriwick's original wedding dress, learning a bit from every woman who wore it. Grace and Noah hit a snag in their relationship as Abigail and Phil start to ramp up theirs, leading to a potential future where Phil makes Middleton his home.

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E09 - How to Make a Middleton Quilt
4.plot: Grace, in a true Middleton tradition, enlists the help of the town in making a magical quilt that's said to grant the wishes of the recipient-- and seemingly all that contribute to it. Cassie and Sam learn even more about each other as secrets are revealed at their bachelor/ette parties-- with a special Middleton twist!

4.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E10 - Tossing the Bouquet
4.plot: After a series of unfortunate events, Sam and Cassie have to accept that their wedding might not be as perfect as planned. In light of her almost-romance with Phil, Abigail's quest to put down roots lands her a new job-- the Mayor of Middleton.

FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S04E12 -

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E01 - The Forever Tree Pt. 1
5.plot: Cassie and Sam’s wedding is just days away and as the town of Middleton prepares for this highly anticipated event, Grace is troubled when wedding related hiccups keep occurring. Abigail opens up to the idea of handing her mayor responsibilities over to Martha, but a handsome stranger puts a wrench in her plans. Meanwhile, Stephanie finds herself smitten.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E02 - The Forever Tree Pt. 2
5.plot: Cassie and Sam’s wedding day has arrived and Sam doubles his efforts to find the Forever Tree. He gets a magical assist from Grace, who’s nostalgic for her late father.  Mayor Abigail makes a surprising ally while Martha finds a new passion. Nick takes a step toward finding his calling.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E03 - The Honeymoon
5.plot: While honeymooning, Cassie and Sam help a new friend reconcile with her brother. Grace attempts to speed up time after a break-up. Sparks fly between Abigail and Blairsville’s mayor. Martha freezes at her TV audition. Nick ghost hunts at Grey House with a friend, who’s looking for more than spirits.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E04 - The Prince
5.plot: Cassie hosts a guest with a surprising secret. Sam’s visiting friend needs medical expertise but the cure may lie in Cassie’s intuition. Grace interns for Martha at City Hall and faces competition from a fellow intern. Martha prepares the first episode of her show, and Stephanie considers her romantic options.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E05 - The Tea
5.plot: Cassie uses her enchanting powers — and tea — to help Abigail open up to Donovan.  Mayor Martha critiques an artist painting her portrait.  Sam’s new resident needs a lesson in bedside manner.  Grace is disappointed after being rejected by her top college choice, while Nick’s confidence wavers after his acceptance.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E06 - The Road Trip
5.plot: Cassie’s being honored by her alma mater and visits with Grace, who’s considering enrolling.  Grace bonds with her weekend host, while Cassie reconnects with her college friend.  Needing a break from Donovan, Abigail joins.  At Grey House, Sam tries to channel Cassie while helping his father-son guests communicate better.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E07 - The Grey-cation
5.plot: Cassie and Sam welcome the Tinsdales at Grey House but a friendly game highlights how much the newlyweds still don’t know about each other. Grace dates her fellow intern, who has ulterior motives. Abigail meets Donovan’s mother, who believes a curse should keep them apart.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E08 - The Treasure
5.plot: Cassie encourages Sam to look for mysteries to unlock as Martha unearths a long-lost town charter and treasure map. Vincent searches for the treasure but he faces competition. Grace is hurt when she learns what Luke’s been up to.  Abigail reassesses her relationship with Donovan.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E09 - The Comet
5.plot: Middleton prepares to wish upon Posner’s Comet but Cassie worries wishing won’t help when Sam’s offered a dream job across the country. Grace prepares her valedictorian speech, while Nick becomes nostalgic.  Abigail plans a trip to forget about Donovan, who tries to win her back.

5.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E10 - The Graduation
5.plot: Cassie and Sam prepare to send Grace and Nick to college, but Nick’s mom worries about his move. Grace uncovers her true passion. A curse may keep Abigail from reciprocating Donovan’s feelings. The hunt for Middleton’s treasure leads Sam and Martha to a surprising discovery.

FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S05E12 -

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E01 - The Anniversary
6.plot: Now empty-nesters, Cassie and Sam celebrate their first wedding anniversary. Abigail and Donovan’s relationship continues to be challenged by their families’ curse. Cassie’s Grey House guest has intentions for visiting Middleton that are different than she claims.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E02 - The Chili
6.plot: Cassie judges Middleton’s chili cook-off, which brings out fierce competition among residents, including Sam. Martha receives unexpected competition in her once-uncontested run for re-election. Cassie unearths a time capsule that reveals information about her current Grey House guest’s background.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E03 - The Clock
6.plot: Cassie, Abigail and Joy browse an estate sale, where Joy hopes to find a clock for Martha's renovation. Stephanie's ex-husband, Wes, comes to town to pack up their shared cabin.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E04 - The Dinner
6.plot: Martha fills in as the local Dear Debbie advice columnist, getting an anonymous letter that adds intrigue to a progressive dinner attended by all of the Middleton couples.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E05 - The Mandala
6.plot: Cassie pursues a temporary art history professorship while Sam diagnoses Adam. Abigail and Donovan realize that the missing diamond from the Middleton treasure may help break the curse.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E06 - The Dream
6.plot: Cassie gives her art history students a lesson on perspective. Sam performs surgery on Adam, who worries about his recovery. Joy’s troubling dream about Abigail and Donovan may not be what it seems. Martha courts a French delegation to secure Middleton’s status as its sister city.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E07 - The Tableau
6.plot: As Cassie gets ready for Grey House’s 225th birthday Martha leads the group in a tableau vivant recreating a Nathaniel Merriwick painting, leading to new clues surrounding the Merriwick-Davenport curse. Joy experiences life differently when her intuition suddenly takes a holiday.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E08 - The Chocolates
6.plot: Cassie welcomes a chocolate festival to Grey House where the confection has a special, sweet effect. Sam and Donovan discover a new clue surrounding the Merriwick-Davenport curse, while now-single Abigail gets an unexpected visit from a college friend for a surprising reason.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E09 - The Loft
6.plot: When Cassie and Sam’s weekend in Chicago gets canceled because Sam has to stay behind for work, she and her book club friends hit the road instead. While the ladies recharge the weekend also comes with surprises, including a potential clue about the Merriwick-Davenport curse.

6.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S06E10 - The Bird
6.plot: Cassie’s teaching position winds down and Sam is forced to take vacation time so they try out different hobbies together. Joy’s faced with a decision when Donna accepts a job for them in Vermont. Abigail and Donovan make one last stand against the curse.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E01 - The Party
7.plot: Cassie and Sam's much overdue date doesn't go as planned, and they end up stranded on an island.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E02 - The Shell
7.plot: Cassie, Abigail and Joy learn the origins of the pouches of soil but have more questions than answers. Cassie and Sam's double date with hospital administrator Grant and his girlfriend, Monica, doesn't go quite as planned. All of Middleton flashes back to the '50s when Martha organizes a "Grease" themed movie night in the park that ends with a surprise romantic gesture.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E03 - The Delivery
7.plot: Cassie, Stephanie and Abigail help Martha throw Claire a baby shower, sparking memories of Cassie's own baby shower.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E04 - The Exchange
7.plot: Sam is excited to perform surgery on a star basketball player. Joy makes a discovery and decides to revive the Middleton Exchange tradition.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E05 - The Kite
7.plot: Joy's dream sends the three Merriwicks on a search for Phillip Harper, Joy's father.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E06 - The Wishes
7.plot: When Cassie, Abigail, and Joy toss coins into the historic wishing well, wishes old and new start coming true.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E07 - The Magic
7.plot: As the Merriwicks delve into the images on Joy's vision board, Cassie accompanies Sam on a trip to his childhood home to care for his sister.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E08 - The Sprint
7.plot: Cassie and Sam are disagreeing about his return to work after his shoulder surgery. Flower Universe is trying to undercut Abigail's business, but she won't go down without a fight. Martha and Tom's special anniversary celebration brings all their friends together.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E09 - The Search
7.plot: The pressure is on because strange things start happening to Cassie, Abigail and Joy's abilities, adding urgency to finding a Merriwick family heirloom.

7.title: FR - Un Soupçon de magie - S07E10 - The Wedding
7.plot: Cassie, Abigail and Joy get ready to face the mysterious force that threatens the Merriwick family legacy. Series finale.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E01 - Toppled
1.plot: The peaceful Mexican town of San Simon and a trio of Daoist martial arts pupils are attacked by a mutated initiate from an occult crime organization.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E02 - Grief
1.plot: Chiu's students are left reeling in the wake of their loss. El Balde summons his fellow jefes and transforms them into flesh-eating monsters.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E03 - Night of the Wolves
1.plot: Brister and Garcia seek clues to the origins of the demonic creatures while Isabela, Jesus and Silencio do the same as they mourn their fallen master.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E04 - Caged Dogs
1.plot: After uncovering the truth about their peaceful town, Isabela and Jesus are arrested while Silencio becomes a fugitive. El Balde comes to San Simon.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E05 - Blindfold
1.plot: El Balde terrorizes the town of San Simon while Chiu's students meet Lo, their former master's brother. Brister and Garcia try to rescue Garabina.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E06 - Reunion
1.plot: Lo's true nature emerges. Isabela, Silencio and Jesus join forces with Brister and Garcia to raid El Balde's compound and find his mother, Alejandra.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E07 - Between This World and the Next
1.plot: An earth-shattering showdown unfolds between El Balde and his mother, Alejandra, who has possessed the body of Isabela. Silencio succumbs to anger.

1.title: FR - Seis Manos - S01E08 - The Empty Place
1.plot: The team battles a surprising nemesis with seemingly insurmountable powers. He reveals Chiu's secret past -- and offers Silencio a fateful choice.

meta.plot: Trois orphelins élevés par un maître des arts martiaux vivent une violente aventure réunissant pouvoirs démoniaques, cartels, rites et sacrifices sanglants.

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Premiere episode - 1
1.plot: The youngest head of the Israeli Security Agency in the nation’s history must confront a massive leak that threatens to upend both his career and the organization.

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Who can he trust?
1.plot: His greatest fear comes true and everyone closest to him becomes a suspect. Who can he trust?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Itamar Crosses the Lines
1.plot: His most important agent is in danger, and to save her he is about to cross the lines for the first time. How far will Itamar go?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The most loyal or the most dangerous?
1.plot: Is Scully, the closest and most loyal man to Itamar, also the most dangerous man? Is Itamar's most important operation at risk?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - The Turning Point
1.plot: The turning point of the season from the first minute to the last. Will Itamar be able to solve everything?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Trap
1.plot: The head of the Shin Bet makes an extreme move. What is he about to discover and is everything about to change?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Brilliant operation or dangerous mistake
1.plot: The head of the Shin Bet sends fighters to an operation in Gaza. A brilliant move? Or a mistake that will cost him dearly?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Suspect in the House
1.plot: Itamar's wife becomes the main suspect, but what if he's wrong?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Season Finale
1.plot: What will happen to his son? What is his wife planning? Who is the leaker? And what will happen to the head?

meta.plot: La série suit la vie d'Itamar Molcho, directeur du Shin Bet (service de sécurité intérieure israélien), durant un mois tumultueux qui bouleverse sa vie professionnelle et personnelle. Au fil des épisodes, la plus grave fuite de l'histoire du Shin Bet est révélée, faisant naître des soupçons qui planent sur tous ses proches.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E01 - Perpetratin'
1.plot: Autumn Night, a mysterious beauty with a harrowing past washes up on the shores of the Pynk seeking employment. Mercedes Sundayz, a night headlined by the club's OG, brings unexpected trouble from a number of patrons.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E02 - Scars
1.plot: The Pynk's annual carwash receives a visit from a surprising guest while Autumn's past comes back to haunt her. Back at the club, souls are bared, and deals are negotiated in the private booths.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E03 - Higher Ground
1.plot: Autumn dons a bold new look and learns the rules of working a "regular" from The "Trinity," each of whom receives a visit from her favorite repeat customer. Uncle Clifford learns about big changes coming to Chucalissa.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E04 - The Trap
1.plot: Mercedes and Autumn make major moves toward building new lives for themselves. At the Pynk, gossip spreads like wildfire, and patrons flood in for a big night.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E05 - Belly
1.plot: Two foes find themselves trapped together for a weekend under unlikely circumstances. Keyshawn reaches new heights, and Lil' Murda glows up big time.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E06 - Legacy
1.plot: All throughout the Pynk, surprising new bonds are formed as everyone fights to secure their bag and their future. Andre faces pushback on his deal with the warring Kyle brothers.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E07 - Last Call For Alcohol
1.plot: Uncle Clifford goes to war for the hearts and minds of Chucalissa.;back at the club, the Pynk family comes together to prepare for its biggest night yet.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E08 - Murda Night
1.plot: Folks from Biloxi to Atlanta pack out the Pynk to see two shining stars on a unforgettable night. Meanwhile, Autumn's past finally catches up with her. Season Finale.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E01 - Pussyland
2.plot: Still reeling from the events of Murda Night, the Pynk family faces off against a new foe: Rona.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E02 - Seven Pounds of Pressure
2.plot: While The Pynk staff prepares for their biggest night yet, Uncle Clifford reaches a personal milestone.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E03 - The Dirty Dozen
2.plot: Keyshawn and Lil’ Murda embark on a new adventure. Meanwhile, Mercedes ventures into uncharted territory.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E04 - Demethrius
2.plot: While Keyshawn’s glow-up continues, Big Teak struggles with life on the outside. Back in Chucalissa, The Pynk is visited by a surprise guest.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E05 - White Knights
2.plot: Sit on down and get ready to learn the history of Mississippi...

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E06 - Savage
2.plot: Andre’s mayoral campaign picks up speed as Autumn and Uncle Clifford wage war. Mercedes finds herself further entangled in Memphis. Back in Chucalissa, Lil’ Murda helps Big Teak find his footing in a broken new world.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E07 - Jackson
2.plot: Uncle Clifford wrestles with her future while opening the door to the past. Meanwhile, Mercedes struggles with the complexities of motherhood.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E08 - The Death Drop
2.plot: Some folks across Chucalissa fight for what’s theirs, while others struggle to accept the things they can’t change.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E09 - Snow
2.plot: The Pynk framily shows up and shows out, giving folks a night they won’t ever forget...

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E10 - Mississippi Rule
2.plot: It’s the big finale, y’all. New beginnings and endings abound in Chucalissa.

meta.plot: Au fin fond du delta du Mississippi se trouve une oasis de paillettes au milieu de trajectoires humaines violentes où la beauté peut-être difficile à trouver. Chaque épisode retrace l’histoire kaléidoscopique d’un petit club de strip-tease où des personnages haut en couleurs franchissent ses portes, qu’ils soient brisés par la vie, plein d’espoir ou complètement perdus.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E01 - TNT
1.plot: Thony, a whip-smart Cambodian doctor, struggles to make ends meet as an undocumented worker after coming to the U.S. from the Philippines in search of a medical treatment for her ailing son. After witnessing a murder, Thony cleans the crime scene to stay alive, then begins living a double life, cleaning for a crime syndicate while doing what is necessary to save her son.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E02 - The Lion's Den
1.plot: Thony attempts to sever ties with the crime syndicate when the FBI comes asking questions. But when her son’s health declines, she crosses a moral line, getting deeper involved with the syndicate. Meanwhile, things turn violent during a weapons exchange when inventory goes missing and Arman has 24 hours to find the thief.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E03 - Legacy
1.plot: Thony is given a dire ultimatum by Garrett that could compromise her son's access to medical treatment. Arman is tasked with collecting large "donations" for Hayak's daughter's wedding, calling into question his real role within the family. Meanwhile, a rift forms between Fiona and her son, Chris, when a secret is revealed that has major consequences for his future, sending Fiona into a spiral as she tries to find a solution.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E04 - Kabayan
1.plot: Facing a heartbreaking setback with Luca's treatment, Thony desperately takes matters into her own hands. But when a potential donor refuses to participate, she turns to Arman for help, who escalates the situation to get results. Meanwhile, Garrett makes a risky demand of Thony, pushing her deeper into moral ambiguity.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E05 - The Icebox
1.plot: When a party bus cleanup job takes a turn for the worse, and Garrett puts Thony in a threatening position, she must choose between her loyalty to Arman and saving Fiona from deportation. Meanwhile, after all his efforts to secure a new business for Hayak, Arman is blindsided when Hayak chooses his daughter over him.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E06 - Mother's Mission
1.plot: Since their brush with ICE, Fiona and Thony’s relationship is strained, as a result of Thony’s lies. Meanwhile, Arman uses Thony’s relationship with Garrett to feed information to the FBI. Then, as Luca’s health declines, Thony must decide if she can work with Mother Donna, who may be a potential resource for a liver transplant for Luca, but at what cost to Thony.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E07 - Our Father, Who Art in Vegas
1.plot: Thony's marital issues are amplified as Marco begins asking tough questions about her methods of getting Luca life-saving treatments. Meanwhile, Arman is determined to make his way out from under Hayak, but Garrett is hell-bent on foiling his plans.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E08 - Full on Gangsta
1.plot: Thony enlists Arman’s help to get to Mexico for Luca’s transplant, but plans go dangerously off course when Hayak finds out Arman is lying to him. Thony finds herself in a desperate situation, forcing her to call upon both the former doctor and the newfound “gangsta” in herself.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E09 - Coming Home Again
1.plot: Arman's fallout with Hayak has severe consequences for Thony, who must now find her way back home from Mexico with Luca. In hiding, Arman tries to help Thony get back, but it is Garrett who steps in to get Thony across the border where, upon re-entry, things aren't what they seem.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E10 - The Crown
1.plot: In need of a way out, Thony tries to make a deal with Garrett to save herself and help Arman; Loyalties are put to the test as families both unite and fall apart.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E01 - Sins of the Father
2.plot: Season Two picks up with Thony desperately trying to find her son, Luca, after he was kidnapped by his father Marco. With nowhere else to turn, she enlists the help of FBI Agent Garrett Miller to track him down before they leave the country. Meanwhile, an incident involving Chris forces Fiona to shield her son by any means necessary.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E02 - Lolo and Lola
2.plot: Thony's in-laws (Fiona's loving-yet-overbearing father and reserved-yet-strong mother) come to Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Thony must help Arman by meeting with Robert Kamdar, Nadia's gregarious and charming ex-lover.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E03 - El Diablo Que Conoces
2.plot: Thony must team up with Arman and Nadia in a new money-making venture to save Luca's life. Meanwhile, Fiona works to keep Chris out of trouble when the threat of evidence arises.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E04 - Bahala Na
2.plot: After Fiona puts herself in a dangerous situation, Thony resorts to calling Arman for help, which continues to drive a wedge between Arman and Nadia. Meanwhile, Garrett works to get put back on the Cortez case, and Chris struggles with the emotional aftermath of recent events.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E05 - The Brit
2.plot: Arman and Nadia attempt to take control of their drug-selling venture when they realize Thony’s ethical methods aren’t making them enough money. Meanwhile, Fiona takes the lead on starting her and Thony’s new cleaning business and Garrett is one step closer to solving the Cortes case.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E07 - Truth or Consequences
2.plot: Detective Flores digs deeper into the cause of Marco's death. Meanwhile, Thony, Arman and Garrett team up to bring down Kamdar.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E08 - Spousal Privilege
2.plot: JD temporarily takes in Fiona and the kids during a time of need. Meanwhile, Garrett changes strategies in his attempt to stop Kamdar.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E09 - The Ask
2.plot: As Luca grows sicker, Thony will do anything to get him a new medication, including asking Kamdar for help. Meanwhile, Arman confronts Nadia about her secret.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E10 - Trust
2.plot: As Arman and Nadia plan their most dangerous scheme yet, Thony questions her alliances, especially with Luca's health deteriorating. Meanwhile, Garrett zeroes in on a suspect in Maya's death.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E11 - Sanctuary
2.plot: Thony is confronted by Garrett regarding the truth behind Maya's death as Nadia tries to stay on Kamdar's good side. Meanwhile, Fiona helps Luca celebrate his birthday.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E12 - At Long Last
2.plot: After Thony, Arman and Garrett work together to come up with a plan to take down Kamdar once and for all, Thony decides to take things into her own hands to ensure the safety of Fiona and Luca. Season finale.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E01 - Arman
3.plot: When Arman mysteriously disappears, Thony and Nadia begrudgingly team up to look for him. Meanwhile, Fiona tries to manage the aftermath of her deportation to the Philippines and reconnects with an old flame.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E02 - For My Son
3.plot: Thony turns to Ramona to get Fiona back to the United States but finds herself indebted. Meanwhile, a secret Fiona has kept hidden for decades comes to light, creating friction between herself and family members.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E03 - El Camino del Diablo
3.plot: When Thony is tasked with cleaning cars for Ramona, she comes across a distressed woman in need of medical attention. Fiona attempts to return to the States and Nadia confronts Agent Russo for information about Arman's disappearance.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E04 - Agua, Fuego, Tierra, Viento
3.plot: As Luca's CPS interview nears, Thony focuses on getting Fiona back home with the help of Jorge. Meanwhile, Nadia continues to investigate Arman's disappearance and finds herself face-to-face with Ramona.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E05 - All of Me
3.plot: When Thony and Fiona are faced with a terrifying situation, they set out to fix it before it's too late. Meanwhile, Jorge throws a wrench in Ramona's plan to find Arman, and Ramona starts to question his allegiance.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E06 - El Reloj
3.plot: Thony gets a new lead on Arman's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Ramona tries to cut a deal with Nadia and Luca attends his first day of school.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E07 - Velorio
3.plot: Ramona grows increasingly more apprehensive of Thony's involvement in Arman's life and suspects Thony and Nadia of jeopardizing her and Jorge's plans. Meanwhile, Jeremy volunteers to install security equipment at Fiona's house.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E08 - Know Thy Enemy
3.plot: As Thony starts to spiral, Fiona grows tired of her antics and goes to Russo for help. Meanwhile, Ramona and Jorge focus on cleaning up Arman's mess, ensuring nothing can be traced back to them.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E09 - From the Ashes
3.plot: Ramona considers an offer from Thony that causes a shift in their dynamic. Jorge teams up with Nadia as a way to use her connections and Russo's team gets closer to breaking their case open.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E10 - Smoke and Mirrors
3.plot: After finding hidden cameras in her home, Thony attempts to get her family's normal life back by turning down a powerful offer from Ramona. Meanwhile, Jorge proposes a new money-laundering venture to Nadia. Then, Ramona and Jorge's properties are searched by the FBI after Russo obtains a warrant against them.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E11 - Fight or Flight
3.plot: As Ramona continues her attempts to recruit Thony into her business, Thony and Fiona work with the FBI to help Nadia. Meanwhile, the FBI starts organizing a plan to take down Ramona inside her own event.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E12 - House of Cards
3.plot: Russo receives a terrifying warning from Sin Cara and Jorge gets news that could alter his alliances.

meta.plot: Lorsque Thony De La Rosa, une médecin cambodgienne, vient aux États-Unis pour faire soigner son fils, elle découvre que son chemin ne sera pas aussi simple qu'elle l'avait espéré. Alors que le système lui fait rapidement défaut, la poussant à se cacher, elle décide de ne pas se laisser abattre et marginaliser, et devient une femme de ménage pour le crime organisé. Utilisant sa ruse et son intelligence, Thony se fraye un chemin dans la pègre, faisant tout ce qu'elle doit pour survivre.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E12 - #MotorcycleMystery

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E13 - #SecretSafe

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E16 - #PeezyB
1.plot: Sam gets a job as the assistant to the huge rap star Peezy B. Cat finds babysitting much more challenging without Sam around to help.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E17 - #SalmonCat
1.plot: An old TV show's title causes problems for the girls because it's similar to their business's name, so Sam and Cat try to find the show's creators, who are in the midst of a long-standing feud.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E18 - #Twinfection
1.plot: Cat pranks Sam by using a pair of twins they're watching, and Sam gets even by pranking Cat with Melanie, Sam's twin sister.

meta.plot: Sam & Cat est une sitcom américaine pour adolescents qui a été créée le 8 juin 2013 sur Nickelodeon. Il s'agit d'un spin-off croisé d'iCarly et de Victorious. Il met en vedette Jennette McCurdy dans le rôle de Sam Puckett et Ariana Grande dans le rôle de Cat Valentine. Les filles se rencontrent par hasard au cours d'une aventure bizarre et deviennent colocataires, puis lancent une entreprise de baby-sitting pour gagner de l'argent supplémentaire.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E01 - Decide
1.plot: While Léa balances her new role as a rabbi with her atheist father’s skepticism, she begins to face the many challenges in guiding others.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E02 - Enjoy
1.plot: Léa is summoned when 12-year-old Noé refuses a bar mitzvah -- to his father’s dismay. Meanwhile, Léa and Joël’s grandmother goes missing.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E03 - The Fabric of Generations
1.plot: A man seeks Léa's counsel in honoring his late mother's wishes. Later, Léa finds herself on a strange date.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E04 - Jacob and Rachel and Léa
1.plot: After being asked to officiate her first wedding, Léa discovers the groom is her childhood crush.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E05 - The Rebellious Son
1.plot: Léa attempts to reconcile a young believer with his secular parents, even as her own dealings with Arié become increasingly difficult to ignore.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E06 - Spinning
1.plot: After she receives a chair stolen from a Jewish family during World War II, Léa enlists Joël’s help.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E07 - The Pharaohs
1.plot: Léa hosts Passover in her reluctant father’s home, unaware that her guests have unresolved conflicts.

1.title: FR - Reformed - S01E08 - The Four Children
1.plot: As they mourn a tragic death, Léa and her family are forced to confront their underlying tensions.

meta.plot: Léa, 28 ans, est l'une des rares femmes rabbins de France : frêles épaules, grandes responsabilités puisqu'elle doit trouver les réponses dans le labyrinthe de petites et de grandes questions de la vie des gens. Mais comment être un guide pour les autres quand on est soi-même aux prises avec les fondamentaux de l'amour, de la famille et en quête de sens ?

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The Savage family discovers that yet another housekeeper has quit and, while the boys see this as their dad's opportunity to hire a cute French maid, Nick decides it's time his boys learn how to take care of themselves. Stunned, the boys decide that they need a plan to change their dad's mind.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E02 - Tutoring
1.plot: It's progress report time at school, and while the Savage boys – with the exception of Sam – are far from straight A students, Nick can't ignore the fact that Chris is failing five classes this year. The greatest shock is that studious Sam is failing a class, and when the guys find out it's gym, he becomes the butt of everyone's humor in this jock-filled household. When Sam agrees to tutor Chris so he won't be kicked off the football team in exchange for the coach giving him a passing grade in P.E., Sam soon realizes he got the short end of the rope.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E03 - Almost Men in Uniform
1.plot: When Nick and his brother, Jimmy, are called in to work unexpectedly, Nick is forced to take the younger boys, T. J. and Kyle, with him to the fire station, which leaves Sam, Jack and Chris home alone. The boys recently found out that people give firemen in uniform free stuff as a way of showing their gratitude. When they combine this knowledge with the fact that Jimmy just dropped off a bunch of Nick's freshly cleaned uniforms from the dry cleaners, they put two and two together, which equals a heap of trouble.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E04 - Nick Kicks Butt
1.plot: Nick is forced to confront the boys when he finds a pack of cigarettes in the house, and when the guilty party reluctantly owns up to them, he calls Nick on his hypocrisy, as Nick himself smokes cigars. In an effort to convince his son to quit, Nick makes a deal with him that he finds very hard to keep.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E05 - Car Jack
1.plot: When Jack begs his dad to get him his own car, Nick agrees to put up half the money if Jack will raise the other half and, after a series of schemes, he finally comes up with it. Jack's Uncle Jimmy takes him to get the car, but when he comes home with a motorcycle instead, Nick is none too pleased and shows the boys a "Blood on the Highway" – type safety video – which doesn't deter Jack or his brothers one bit.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E06 - Free Lily
1.plot: It's Halloween, and the Savage boys are trying to figure out what to do for their annual prank. Kyle feels he's too old for trick or treating this year, leaving Nick and T.J. to go it alone. When Chris is forced to dissect a frog in class, he gets the idea – via a spooky visit from the ghost of the late class frog – of just what to do for their prank this year.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E07 - For Whom the Cell Tolls
1.plot: Sam's love, Angela, has a new boyfriend, and so Jack, noticing how depressed Sam is, encourages him to go to the mall with him to meet someone else. Sam reluctantly agrees, and when Jack introduces him to a very good looking girl, Erin, Sam can hardly believe it when she agrees to go out with him. It becomes apparent very quickly, however, that Erin's main priority is talking on her cell phone instead of actually talking to him. Meanwhile, Chris has taken a job selling glider planes from a cart in the mall.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E08 - Carnival Knowledge
1.plot: When the boys find out a church carnival is in town, they're all excited to go – each for his own reasons. Jack and Chris devise a plan to pick up on girls who have already entered the fair so they won't have to pay for their admission, and although trying to woo Angela, Sam reluctantly accepts her idea that they can go to the carnival as "friends." Meanwhile, as the boys are causing chaos at the fair, T.J. has to finish his school report before he can go, but when he's done, the dog eats the memory stick containing his report... and T.J. has a very hard time convincing Nick that the dog really did eat his homework.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E09 - My Two Sons
1.plot: In an effort to get him out of the house, the boys decide it's time for Nick to meet a woman. Their attempt at setting him up via an internet dating service backfires, however. When he does find someone he's interested in – Maggie – Nick is afraid she'll be scared off if he tells her the truth about having five sons.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E10 - Thanksgiving With the Savages
1.plot: Nick is excited to spend Thanksgiving – his favorite holiday – with his family, but much to his disappointment, Sam decides to spend it with his girlfriend Angela's family, whom he considers more "civilized." Plans are interrupted, though, when Nick and Jimmy are unexpectedly called away on a fire, so the boys decide to surprise Nick by making Thanksgiving dinner on their own. In looking up the proper way to cook a turkey online, they find a video of Thanksgiving safety tips hosted by none other than Officer Cox. However the stores are now sold out of turkeys, so they resort to buying a live one – and get more than they bargained for. Meanwhile, Sam soon learns that there's more to Angela's seemingly perfect family than meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E11 - The Man Without a Ball
1.plot: When Nick leaves the boys to rake the yard while he goes off to golf with Jimmy, they decide instead to play a game of "rake ball," but accidentally hit their dad's championship baseball over the fence and into mean old Mrs. Riley's yard. When Mrs. Riley refuses to give the ball back, it turns into an all-out feud.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E12 - Voodude
1.plot: Kyle finds himself smitten with Josie, a girl he is used to spending time with in detention, but fears having a girlfriend will turn him into a "wuss." Meanwhile, T.J. and the boys are hard at work on a "destructo-boggan" which is guaranteed to knock all of the inner tubes off the slopes this year, and Sam is poodle-sitting his girlfriend Angela's dog, Sally Sue, which doesn't sit well with the Savage dog.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E13 - Savage XXX-mas
1.plot: Eager to earn money to buy Christmas gifts for their girlfriends, the three older boys find jobs at a lingerie store, but their jobs turn out to be less than glamorous and tensions arise when Sam gets promoted and Chris and Jack are left to do the grunt work. Meanwhile the two younger boys, Evan and T.J., are less than thrilled when Nick puts them to work helping with the fire station's annual toy drive for needy kids.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E14 - Save a Dance For Me
1.plot: Chris is thrilled when he is asked to the "Backwards Dance," in which the girls ask the boys, by Jessica, the hottest girl in school. The only problem is that Jessica is the leader of the dance squad, and Chris – who is a terrible dancer – will have to dance with her in front of the entire school. Meanwhile, there's trouble in paradise when Angela and Sam disagree on plans for the dance; and, in their quest to film each other doing dumb things for an America's Funniest Home Videos-style website, Kyle and T.J. finally drive Nick to the breaking point.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E15 - Teen Things I Hate About You
1.plot: Tired of coming home to a house full of teenagers every Saturday night, Nick brings the boys with him to a town meeting to encourage the city to open a teen center. Nick is none too pleased when they agree, however, as he is given the task of supervising the kids. The boys aren't thrilled either when Nick turns out to be a real stickler for the rules – as opposed to their fun Uncle Jimmy.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E16 - Saving Old Lady Riley
1.plot: The boys administer their own form of CPR – complete with bicycle pump and toilet plunger – on Old Lady Riley when she has a heart attack on their doorstep, and are then wrongfully lauded as heroes. But when they're awarded the "Caring Kid Award," it's just too much to take for one onlooker who happens to know the truth.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E17 - Crimes and Mini-Wieners
1.plot: The principal suspects Kyle, Chris and Sam of starting a food fight and makes them serve as lunch ladies in the school cafeteria for a week as punishment. Meanwhile, Nick is having to work the night shift, and Jack tricks him into hiring April – a girl he has a crush on – to baby-sit T.J..

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E18 - Bad Reception
1.plot: Sam asks Nick and the boys to finally meet his girlfriend Angela's family at her grandmother's birthday party, but they opt to stay home and watch the Super Bowl instead. When their cable goes out in the middle of the game, however, they go over to the quiet birthday party and turn it into their annual Savage Super Bowl Party. Meanwhile, Sam has put together a birthday surprise for Angela's grandmother, which doesn't quite turn out as planned.

meta.plot: Elevés par un père célibataire, les frères Savages ont épuisé une bonne vingtaine de gouvernantes. Nick s'efforce désormais d'apprendre à ses fistons à être indépendant et de se plier aux tâches ménagères. Mais la partie n'est pas gagnée Nick est lui-même un éternel adolescent... Produite entre autres par Mel Gibson, cette sitcom s'inspire de sa propre expérience de père d'une famille nombreuse.

1.plot: Wooju uncovers the 25-year-old truth to save Myungsoon-dang, facing the one behind it all. Meri turns to Sang-hyeon as a scandal shakes Beauté Group.

1.plot: Meri’s ex publicly accuses her and Wooju, igniting a media frenzy as the Myungsoon-dang scandal peaks. Refusing to back down, they confront the chaos.

1.plot: Two of ice hockey's hottest rising stars keep crossing paths on the international stage. As their careers take off, a late-night encounter sparks an unexpected connection.

1.title: FR - Rivalité passionnée - S01E02 - Olympians
1.plot: As their careers reach defining moments, Ilya and Shane continue their secret fling. During the Sochi Winter Olympics, mounting personal and professional pressures test their connection.

1.title: FR - Rivalité passionnée - S01E03 - Hunter
1.plot: A hockey player’s high-stakes career collides with love when a chance meeting ignites a spark.

1.title: FR - Rivalité passionnée - S01E04 - Rose
1.plot: A moment of unexpected vulnerability and a high-profile romance unleash a storm of turmoil for Shane and Ilya.

1.title: FR - Rivalité passionnée - S01E05 - I'll Believe in Anything
1.plot: Shane, Ilya, and Scott each face pivotal personal decisions.

1.title: FR - Rivalité passionnée - S01E06 - The Cottage
1.plot: Shane and Ilya escape the spotlight for a rare moment of freedom.

meta.plot: Two of the biggest stars in Major League Hockey are bound by ambition, rivalry, and a magnetic pull neither of them fully understands. What begins as a secret fling between two fresh faced rookies evolves into a years-long journey of love, denial, and self-discovery. Over the next eight years, as they chase glory on the ice, they struggle to navigate their feelings for each other. Torn between the sport they live for and the love they can’t ignore, they must decide if there’s room in their fiercely competitive world for something as fragile – and powerful – as real love.
