4.plot: An advanced radar experiment conducted high above the Mesa and Triangle reveals evidence that an incredible theory about Skinwalker Ranch could actually be true.

4.title: FR - Les secrets du Skinwalker Ranch - S04E11 - In the Heat of the Night
4.plot: When the team performs a hi-tech experiment at the Triangle, it leads to a stunning revelation that may explain the strange phenomena on Skinwalker Ranch.

4.title: FR - Les secrets du Skinwalker Ranch - S04E12 - In and Out
4.plot: A daring rocket and helicopter experiment results in the team witnessing a phenomenon that might prove an ancient legend about Skinwalker Ranch.

4.title: FR - Les secrets du Skinwalker Ranch - S04E13 - Everything in the Air All at Once
4.plot: As the team conducts their most complex experiment ever at the Triangle, they are stunned as a number of bizarre events unfold before their eyes.

4.title: FR - Les secrets du Skinwalker Ranch - S04E14 - Living in a Metamaterial World
4.plot: After conducting an experiment that reveals more evidence of incredible phenomena in the skies above Skinwalker Ranch, the team learns that the greatest mystery of the property may actually be located deep underground.

meta.plot:
Alors que la plupart des gens se tournent vers les étoiles pour trouver une vie extraterrestre, un groupe de chercheurs fait le contraire : ils cherchent sous terre. Depuis plus de 200 ans, le ranch Skinwalker de l'Utah a été le témoin de centaines d'activités paranormales et d'ovnis.

Malgré des décennies d'études, dont certaines sont secrètement financées par le gouvernement américain, personne n'a osé chercher dans les sols. Aujourd'hui, le légendaire ranch donne un accès complet à une équipe qui se prépare à faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant.

1.title: FR - Malgré moi - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Malgré moi - S01E02 -
FR - Malgré moi - S01E03 -
FR - Malgré moi - S01E04 -

meta.plot: Dans un vol Winnipeg-Montréal, Daphné raconte comment elle a tout laissé à Montréal pour suivre l’amour de sa vie à Winnipeg, Ilunga, et y trouver plutôt une trahison monumentale. Humiliée, elle qui planifiait se venger aurait-elle plutôt trouvé une famille choisie?

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E01 - The Magic Xylophone
1.plot: As Bluey and Bingo squabble over their magic xylophone (that has the power to freeze Dad in space and time) Dad seizes control and freezes Bluey, leaving Bingo as her only hope.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E02 - Hospital
1.plot: Doctor Bluey is needed when Dad gets a very curious x-ray from Nurse Bingo. It seems he has a cat in his tummy, leaving Bluey no choice but to operate immediately!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E03 - Keepy Uppy
1.plot: Bluey, Bingo and Mum are enjoying playing Keepy-Uppy around the house with their last balloon, when Dad joins in and the game becomes the ultimate test of skill.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E04 - Daddy Robot
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo don't want to tidy the playroom, so they get Daddy Robot to do it for them. But when Bluey takes things too far, Daddy Robot malfunctions with disastrous results.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E05 - Shadowlands
1.plot: On a picnic in the park, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands. But when Coco keeps taking shortcuts, Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E06 - The Weekend
1.plot: At the weekend, Bluey and Bingo are playing in the garden with Dad. But Bingo gets upset, when she discovers a walking leaf insect and Dad is too caught up in the game to notice.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E07 - BBQ
1.plot: It's lunchtime on Bluey's back deck! But every BBQ needs a side salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousins asked for!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E08 - Fruitbat
1.plot: Not wanting to go to bed, Bluey tries to dream about being a nocturnal fruit bat so she can stay up all night long and soon finds herself flying through the night sky.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E09 - Horsey Ride
1.plot: When Bluey forgets to put her favourite toy away, cousin Socks grabs it and won't let go! The kids stage a horsey wedding to distract her, with Dad and Uncle Stripe as the horses!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E10 - Hotel
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo run a crazy "Hotel" with Dad as their put upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them the importance of compromise.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E11 - Bike
1.plot: At the park, Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E12 - Bob Bilby
1.plot: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to put down their screens and show him a good time.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E13 - Spy Game
1.plot: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game in the park, their device to control the grown-ups stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E14 - Takeaway
1.plot: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway order, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E15 - Butterflies
1.plot: Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E16 - Yoga Ball
1.plot: Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E17 - Calypso
1.plot: At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song... all except the mysterious Pretzel.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E18 - The Doctor
1.plot: Honey is stuck waiting for Dr Bingo's as the other, more exciting injuries get seen before her. Receptionist Bluey tells her to be patient, some of these cases are a real pickle!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E19 - The Claw
1.plot: When Bluey and Bingo are unable to grab a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum and Dad create their own version at home. But Dad isn't about to make winning easy.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E20 - Markets
1.plot: When Bluey visits the markets with five bucks from the tooth fairy, the options are endless. But as she and Indy scour the stalls for the perfect purchase, spending it proves hard.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E21 - Blue Mountains
1.plot: Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets, exploring the land beyond the Blue Mountains where they outsmart the Cheeky Fox to find the softest beds in the world.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E22 - The Pool
1.plot: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E23 - Shops
1.plot: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E24 - Wagonride
1.plot: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E25 - Taxi
1.plot: Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E26 - The Beach
1.plot: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E27 - Pirates
1.plot: Bluey, Bingo and Missy pretend to be pirates on the hamock swing at the park playground. Missy is frightened of the journey on the imaginary ship, but faces her fear to rescue her friends from the inside stomach of a whale.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E28 - Grannies
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo dress up as grandmothers, but disagree on if grandmothers are able to perform the floss dance or not. Bluey proves that they are not by video calling Nana, but when this upsets Bingo, Bluey decides to teach Nana the dance so that Bingo will keep playing.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E29 - The Creek
1.plot: Dad takes Bluey, Bingo and Mackenzie to the creek after they grow tired of the local playground. Bluey struggles to appreciate the beauty of the natural world surrounding her, until they arrive at the water. Bluey learns to step out of her comfort zone and try new things.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E30 - Fairies
1.plot: When the family suspects that their house has been invaded by fairies, Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad go on a hunt to search for and capture the invisible creatures. Dad accidentally hurts Bingo's feelings and makes it up to her by outsmarting the fairies.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E31 - Work
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo roleplay a day at work. Dad acts as the boss of a drainpipe factory and hires Bluey and Bingo after their successful interviews. The day takes a turn when Bluey takes control of the company and fires Dad for his breach of the strict "no dancing" rules.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E32 - Bumpy and the Wise Old Wolfhound
1.plot: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and her Dad make, and send her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E33 - Trampoline
1.plot: When Dad has to stop having fun with the girls and go to work, Bluey and Bingo scramble to keep him playing games with them on the trampoline at the same time.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E34 - The Dump
1.plot: Dad takes Bluey and Bingo on a car trip to the dump to throw away rubbish. Bluey asks Dad a range of questions on the way and he proclaims that he knows everything. But when they arrive, Bluey is saddened to learn that he is throwing away her old drawings.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E35 - Zoo
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo set up a pretend zoo at home in the backyard, with Bluey acting as the zookeeper who takes Bingo and Mum on a tour around the grounds. Bluey must devise a plan to catch the baboon (Dad) when he escapes the enclosure and takes Bingo along with him.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E36 - Backpackers
1.plot: Bluey, Bingo, Muffin and Socks roleplay a pretend backpacking adventure around the backyard. The children become the backpacks as Mum and Dad are tasked with carrying them around while exploring their holiday destination.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E37 - The Adventure
1.plot: Bluey plays with Chloe and pretends to be a horse as she accompanies the princess on an imaginary adventure to find food at the family farm. The friends swap roles and adopt a variety of personas as they save the kingdom from an evil queen.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E38 - Copycat
1.plot: Dad wakes to find Bluey copying his every move. While the pair are playing outside, Bluey finds an injured budgie. They take the bird to the vet and learn that it has died. When they get home, Bluey reenacts the events with Bingo to cope with the budgie's death.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E39 - The Sleepover
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo's cousin Muffin arrives for a sleepover in an extremely tired state. Uncle Stripe explains that Muffin is transitioning from her daily naps. The sisters stay up late and play a game with Muffin, before helping her get to sleep when they realise she is exhausted.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E40 - Early Baby
1.plot: When Rusty and Indy's two separate games at Bluey's playgroup come into conflict, the groups explain their different activities to each other. After sharing, the friends find common ground with their games, and they decide to play together.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E41 - Mums and Dads
1.plot: While playing "Mums and Dads", Rusty and Indy have a disagreement about which parent should work, leading them to play separately. However, when they find that their friends have different ideas about how to play the game, the pair return to playing with each other again.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E42 - Hide and Seek
1.plot: Bluey plays Hide and Seek with Bingo, Mum and Dad, but is quickly distracted by her toys, leaving her family hiding around the house undiscovered. When she slows down and focuses, Bluey remembers the game and successfully finds her family.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E43 - Camping
1.plot: Bluey meets a French Labrador called Jean-Luc while on a camping trip with her family. The pair play together and build a camp site, but when Dad acts as a wild pig, the pair must find a way to communicate to combat the pig. Bluey is saddened when Jean-Luc leaves.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E44 - Mount Mumandad
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo pretend that Mum and Dad are a mountain when they are tasked with playing a game without their parents' participation. Bluey races ahead to reach the summit while Bingo brings along a backpack to carry the climbing equipment.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E45 - Kids
1.plot: During a visit to the supermarket, Bluey adopts the role of the parent while Dad must act as the child alongside Bingo. When he tries to fill the trolley with the groceries, Dad gets in trouble with Bluey for being a disobedient child.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E46 - Chickenrat
1.plot: Before bed, Bingo loses her favourite cuddly toy. Mum helps Bluey and Bingo retrace their steps to find the lost item. The siblings recount their adventures as they remember playing with Dad, who was pretending to be a "chickenrat" creature.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E47 - Neighbours
1.plot: Bluey builds a pretend house and gains some new neighbours when Bingo, Mum and Dad move into the street. Bluey must learn to get along with a difficult neighbour when Bingo invades her space and spills over onto her property.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E49 - Asparagus
1.plot: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to use manners while eating dinner at the dining table. However, when Mum gives Bluey a stick of asparagus which magically turns the family into animals, Bluey discovers the importance of manners while trying to control everyone.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E50 - Shaun
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo try to convince Dad to get a pet, but he insists that they already have a pet; a disobedient emu called Shaun. Dad's hand transforms into Shaun and the siblings learn how to look after their new pet by feeding, bathing and walking him.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E51 - Daddy Putdown
1.plot: While Mum is out for the night at a friend's baby shower, Dad must put Bluey and Bingo to bed as part of their evening routine. When the siblings are missing their mother, Bluey decides to set up a pretend baby shower of her own to take her mind off her anxiety.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E52 - Verandah Santa
1.plot: It's Christmas Eve and Dad and the kids are taking turns pretending to be Santa! But when Socks nips Bluey and Bluey refuses to leave her a present, they must all learn the true meaning of being good for Christmas.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E01 - Dance Mode
2.plot: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in 'Dance Mode' as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E02 - Hammerbarn
2.plot: On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour Bingo.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E03 - Featherwand
2.plot: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E04 - Squash
2.plot: When Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don’t always beat little siblings.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E05 - Hairdressers
2.plot: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Bert Handsome has nits! To help treat them, Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E06 - Stumpfest
2.plot: Dad and his mates hit the backyard, ready to rip up some tree stumps! But when Bluey and Bingo take over a stump as a nail salon, Dad finds he's got some negotiating to do.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E07 - Favourite Thing
2.plot: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game. But nothing seems to work.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E08 - Daddy Dropoff
2.plot: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E09 - Bingo
2.plot: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E10 - Rug Island
2.plot: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything - bananas, campfires, even a snake! But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E11 - Charades
2.plot: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play Charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nanna must think quickly to keep the game on track.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E12 - Sticky Gecko
2.plot: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E13 - Dad Baby
2.plot: When Dad shows the kids how to use their old baby-harness, a new game is born: Dad Baby! But Dad is unprepared for the harsh realities of giving birth to a baby Bingo.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E14 - Mum School
2.plot: Bluey plays mum to a brood of bouncy balloons, including an irrepressible floater named Greenie. But she soon discovers that mothering is much harder than she imagined.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E15 - Trains
2.plot: All aboard the Dad Train! Bingo goes from home to daycare to her job at the vet every morning, but there's trouble on the line as a mischievous Bluey throws everyone off schedule.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E16 - Army
2.plot: Jack's the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E17 - Fancy Restaurant
2.plot: Bingo and Bluey want Mum and Dad to smoochy kiss, so they set up a romantic evening for two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes to plan until Chef Bingo's special arrives.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E01 - Perfect
3.plot: Bluey's Father's Day card has to be perfect but she can't decide what to draw! So Mum reminds her about all the fun times she's had with Dad and how he's not so perfect either.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E02 - Bedroom
3.plot: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E03 - Obstacle Course
3.plot: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E04 - Promises
3.plot: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E05 - Omelette
3.plot: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E06 - Born Yesterday
3.plot: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E07 - Mini Bluey
3.plot: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini Bluey!

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E08 - Unicorse
3.plot: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E09 - Curry Quest
3.plot: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E10 - Magic
3.plot: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule - never use magic for cheekiness!

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E11 - Chest
3.plot: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E12 - Sheep Dog
3.plot: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest. But looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E13 - Housework
3.plot: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E14 - Pass the Parcel
3.plot: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E15 - Explorers
3.plot: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E16 - Phones
3.plot: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E17 - Pavlova
3.plot: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Cafe in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E18 - Rain
3.plot: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

meta.plot: Suivez les aventures de Bluey, qui vit avec sa mère, son père et sa sœur. Son énergie irrésistible et son esprit d'aventurière, l'emportent dans une série de situations tout autant drôles qu'imprévisibles.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E01 - Dominus
1.plot: Having no memory of his downfall in "Spartacus: Vengeance," Ashur wakes to find himself the owner of the former House of Batiatus; eager to earn the respect and power he's always desired, Ashur must save face by presenting something new to the arena.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E02 - Forsaken
1.plot: Ashur navigates the treacherous waters of the Roman elites while Achillia struggles to acclimate to the brutal life of a gladiator in training.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E03 - Unworthy
1.plot: Korris faces Ashur's wrath and must prove himself worthy.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E04 - Blood and Bone
1.plot: Ashur frantically tries to enter the Ludi Apollinares games before Marcus Crassus arrives.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E05 - Goddess of Death
1.plot: Ashur presents Achillia to the public, where she faces her first battle in the arena.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E06 - Empty Things
1.plot: Ashur's popularity within Capua soars, but at a devastating cost.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E07 - Deepest Wound
1.plot: Korris demands blood; Ashur attempts to sway an enemy toward his cause.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E08 - Horizons
1.plot: Achillia prepares for her return to the arena, while Ashur faces a devastating setback.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E09 - Those Who Remain
1.plot: Caesar demands a painful sacrifice from Ashur.

1.title: FR - Spartacus: House of Ashur - S01E10 - Hail Caesar
1.plot: Achillia returns to the arena to face her greatest challenge, while Ashur wrestles with the emotional fallout of his actions.

meta.plot: Et si Ashur… n'était pas mort sur le Vésuve ? Et si on lui avait offert la formation des gladiateurs qui appartenait autrefois à Batiatus en échange de son aide aux Romains pour tuer Spartacus et mettre fin à la rébellion des esclaves ?

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E01 - Independence Day (1)
1.plot: Robin, Aqualad, and Kid Flash break into Cadmus and find that it is being run by Genomorphs.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E02 - Fireworks (2)
1.plot: The sidekicks find a clone of Superman known as Superboy. They free him from Cadmus' control, while battling Blockbuster.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E03 - Welcome to Happy Harbor
1.plot: After Speedy declines to join the new team, Robin, Aqualad and Kid Flash fear Young Justice is just a big joke…while new member Miss Martian fears there's no room for her to be part of it. So when the four heroes and Superboy come up against Mister Twister, it looks like all their fears have just been realized…

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E04 - Drop-Zone
1.plot: Young Justice goes on its first official mission under Batman, while trying to determine which of them will lead the team.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E05 - Schooled
1.plot: Superboy's anger over his non-relationship with Superman is getting out of control. He refuses to train with Black Canary, and when the team faces an opponent that even the Justice League had trouble defeating, the Boy of Steel goes rogue.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E06 - Infiltrator
1.plot: Green Arrow's niece, Artemis, joins Young Justice and must save a bright young scientist from the League of Shadows.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E07 - Denial
1.plot: When the team investigates the disappearance of Kent Nelson (formerly Doctor Fate), the scientific-minded Wally West is forced to confront his disbelief in magic while battling Abra Kadabra and Klarion the Witch Boy, for the ultra-powerful Helmet of Fate.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E08 - Downtime
1.plot: After a disastrous mission with the team, Aqualad returns to Atlantis to choose between a life on the surface world or one beneath the waves with the Aquagirl of his dreams. But other forces at play may make Aqualad's decision for him.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E09 - Bereft
1.plot: Young Justice discovers that they have forgotten the last six months of their lives, including each other and a final fateful mission in Bialya. The team turns to Miss Martian to recover their memories, before it is too late for Superboy.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E10 - Targets
1.plot: Red Arrow is on his own against the world's most dangerous assassins in preventing the League of Shadows from starting a war, until he is forced to make an unlikely alliance with someone even more dangerous. Aqualad fails to convince Red Arrow to ask the team for help.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E11 - Terrors
1.plot: Superboy and Miss Martian go undercover inside Belle Reve Penitentiary.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E12 - Homefront
1.plot: When Mount Justice itself is attacked, can Artemis and Robin (the two teens without super-powers) save the Team (or even themselves) from the unknown invaders?

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E13 - Alpha Male
1.plot: Already exhausted and rattled after a home turf invasion of The Cave, the team learns that Aqualad - their friend and leader - withheld vital information that put them all at risk. When Batman sends the Team and new "den-mother" Captain Marvel to India to investigate bizarre reports of armed animals attacking human beings, can Aqualad pull his fractured team together?

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E14 - Revelation
1.plot: When Plant Creatures attack major cities around the world, the team is eager to join the fight alongside the Justice League. Instead, Batman assigns them a still more dangerous task - taking out the plants' masters: a secret society of super- villains: the Injustice League!

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E15 - Humanity
1.plot: The team is on the hunt for Red Tornado, determined to find out once and for all whether the robot was the mole - even if it means kidnapping new friend Zatanna and dragging her along on their quest!

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E16 - Failsafe
1.plot: When the Justice League is defeated during an alien invasion, the Team has to step up and fill their mentors shoes.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E17 - Disordered
1.plot: Superboy's "Sphere" goes through a surprising change, revealing a connection to the forever people of New Genesis.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E18 - Secrets
1.plot: It's Halloween. Artemis and Zatanna are in Manhattan for a girls' night out. There, they encounter the deadly Harm, who has a secret.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E19 - Misplaced
1.plot: When every adult on the planet disappears, only the team, Zatanna, and Billy Batson are left to defeat the five most powerful sorcerers on Earth. In the end, Zatanna officialy joins the team and Zatara becomes the new Doctor Fate.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E20 - Coldhearted
1.plot: Wally West comes oh-so-close to fulfilling his birthday wish to finally fight alongside the Justice League. Instead, a massively disappointed Kid Flash is taken off the mission and tasked with a simple delivery job. But a few deadly surprises await the birthday boy along the way.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E21 - Image
1.plot: A covert operation against Queen Bee in Qurac forces Miss Martian to finally face her greatest fears and her biggest secrets. But will she reveal those secrets to her friends—or allow what she's hiding to take down the entire team?

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E22 - Agendas
1.plot: Superboy returns to Project Cadmus, where he learns the top-secret genetics lab may have created another Super-clone.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E23 - Insecurity
1.plot: Red Arrow's return undercuts Artemis' confidence, while the team's mission to track down Sportsmaster threatens to expose her darkest secrets.

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E24 - Performance
1.plot: The Team goes undercover at the Haly International Traveling Circus to locate a thief stealing weapons technology across Europe. But a thief isn’t all they find…

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E25 - Usual Suspects
1.plot: The Team gets a new member and a new mission – a mission that may finally expose all the Team’s secrets... and all their lies!

1.title: FR - Young Justice - S01E26 - Auld Acquaintance
1.plot: The Team finally learns the identity of the traitor in their midst, forcing a battle against an enemy more dangerous than any they’ve ever faced before!

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E01 - Happy New Year
2.plot: The Team takes on the intergalactic bounty hunter Lobo…as a precursor to an alien invasion!

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E02 - Earthlings
2.plot: Miss Martian, Superboy, Beast Boy and Adam Strange arrive on the distant planet Rann to stop the alien infiltration of Earth at its source.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E03 - Alienated
2.plot: The Team and the Justice League continue to hunt the Kroloteans that have invaded Earth—but the aliens have help from an extremely unexpected source.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E04 - Salvage
2.plot: While Superboy and Blue Beetle battle Intergang, Nightwing and company try to salvage the soul of a former comrade fallen from grace.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E05 - Beneath
2.plot: Jaime Reyes searches for a missing friend, while Miss Martian, Batgirl, Bumblebee and Wonder Girl return to Bialya to discover what lies beneath.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E06 - Bloodlines
2.plot: An intruder mysteriously appears inside Mount Justice, claiming to be a tourist from the future. But who is he really? And what is his true agenda?

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E07 - Depths
2.plot: Artemis rejoins the team to defend a critical satellite launch. But will her first mission back also be her last?!

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E08 - Satisfaction
2.plot: Roy Harper seeks vengeance against the man who ruined his life.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E09 - Darkest
2.plot: Black Manta sends Kaldur on a mission that will prove where his loyalties truly lie.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E10 - Before the Dawn
2.plot: The Team uncovers some shocking secrets while on a covert rescue mission.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E11 - Cornered
2.plot: A brutal alien warrior traps the Team inside the Hall of Justice.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E12 - True Colors
2.plot: Robin leads a squad to investigate Lexcorp's troubling allegiances.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E13 - The Fix
2.plot: In revenge for her telepathic attack on his son, Black Manta goes after Miss Martian.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E14 - Runaways
2.plot: Nightwing tasks Blue Beetle with chasing down a group of potentially dangerous super-powered teenage runaways. But Blue Beetle is not the only one hunting them...

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E15 - War
2.plot: A conqueror from another world becomes a wild card in an intergalactic game of supremacy -- placing planet Earth square in the jackpot.

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E16 - Complications
2.plot: Black Manta gives Miss Martian twenty-four hours to live, but that may be more time than Aqualad has with Sportsmaster and Cheshire on the hunt for his head!

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E17 - The Hunt
2.plot: A band of misfits is put to the test when Lex Luthor sends them behind enemy lines... to rescue the team!

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E18 - Intervention
2.plot: The team embarks on a desperate endeavor to free Blue Beetle!!

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E19 - Summit
2.plot: The Light calls a summit to decide the final fate of Aqualad, the team ... and the entire planet Earth!

2.title: FR - Young Justice - S02E20 - Endgame
2.plot: On the verge of finally ending the alien invasion, the team discovers the price of victory may be the entire planet Earth!

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E01 - Princes All
3.plot: After the Justice League faces a horrifying incident on the planet Rann, Dick Grayson gathers an elite squad of heroes to shut down a meta-human trafficking syndicate in Markovia.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E02 - Royal We
3.plot: Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock, Conner Kent and Jefferson Pierce go undercover in Markovia to stop the Bedlam Syndicate's meta-human trafficking cartel – before it claims another victim

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E03 - Eminent Threat
3.plot: Conner Kent and Prince Biron Markov are in the clutches of Count Vertigo, leaving Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock and an emotionally damaged Jefferson Pierce to save them and put an end to the Bedlam Syndicate.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E04 - Private Security
3.plot: After the Justice League faces a horrifying incident on the planet Rann, Dick Grayson gathers an elite squad of heroes to shut down a meta-human trafficking syndicate in Markovia.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E05 - Away Mission
3.plot: Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock, Conner Kent and Jefferson Pierce go undercover in Markovia to stop the Bedlam Syndicate's meta-human trafficking cartel – before it claims another victim

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E06 - Rescue Op
3.plot: Brion Markov is determined to rescue his missing sister – even if it means throwing down against the entire League of Shadows.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E07 - Evolution
3.plot: Aliens again threaten the Earth, but with the Justice League split and scattered, only the planet’s first and greatest hero can save the day.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E08 - Triptych
3.plot: As Meta-Human trafficking spreads across the United States, three very different teams of heroes hope to put a stop to it.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E09 - Home Fires
3.plot: The Light has hired an intergalactic assassin, but who is the intended target?!

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E10 - Exceptional Human Beings
3.plot: The search for Tara Markov continues – but who’s doing the searching and where?!

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E11 - Another Freak
3.plot: It’s the first day of school for Violet Harper and Forager. And the last day for a different freak…

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E12 - Nightmare Monkeys
3.plot: Garfield Logan tests out a pair of Goode VR goggles. Then the goggles test him!

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E13 - True Heroes
3.plot: Grayson’s operatives attempt to stop an auction of enslaved meta-teens.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E14 - Influence
3.plot: The team reassembles as the Justice League faces a new threat in space.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E15 - Leverage
3.plot: A new Gamma Squad team is sent out on its first mission to investigate rumors of meta-trafficking in Russia.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E16 - Illusion of Control
3.plot: Across the nation, the team members give thanks for what they have -- and for what they very well might lose.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E17 - First Impression
3.plot: The Reach are back, terrorizing small town America… unless the Outsiders can stop them!

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E18 - Early Warning
3.plot: Project Rutabaga threatens to create an international crisis for the Outsiders.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E19 - Elder Wisdom
3.plot: The Outsiders face Lex Luthor's machinations, but Lex is not the only one trying to manipulate them.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E20 - Quiet Conversations
3.plot: Victor Stone reaches a crisis point -- but he's not the only one.

3.title: FR - Young Justice - S03E21 - Unknown Factors
3.plot: Dick Grayson and Jefferson go after Gretchen Goode -- and they encounter the ominous Overlord.

meta.plot: Teenage superheroes strive to prove themselves as members of the Justice League.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: CBI consultant Patrick Jane, Senior Agent Teresa Lisbon and her team investigate the double murder in Palm Springs of a pro golfer's wife and her doctor, which has the hallmarks of a serial killer with a personal connection to Jane.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E02 - Red Hair and Silver Tape
1.plot: While Lisbon and her team investigate the murder of a young waitress in the Napa Valley, Jane goes behind Lisbon's back to orchestrate his own undercover operation using Van Pelt as bait.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E03 - Red Tide
1.plot: When a high school girl's body washes up on the beach, Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap in order to get her surfing friends to turn on each other and reveal what really happened.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E04 - Ladies in Red
1.plot: When the team learns that a wealthy investment banker found murdered inside his locked safe room was living a dual life and skimming millions from clients, Patrick Jane sets up a mental conundrum to see which of the suspects will show their true colors.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E05 - Redwood
1.plot: When a girl is found covered in blood and holding the murder weapon that killed her best friend, she becomes an obvious suspect, though she can't remember anything. But Jane, believing she's innocent, engineers a risky maneuver in which she must relive the terrifying events in order to spark her memory.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E06 - Red Handed
1.plot: While investigating the case of a murdered casino owner, Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to ultimately entrap the killer, and win big at the card tables.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E07 - Seeing Red
1.plot: Patrick Jane goes head-to-head with a "psychic" he suspects of murder. Intent on proving the so-called psychic is a fraud -- as well as a killer -- Jane arranges a séance to expose the murderer.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E08 - The Thin Red Line
1.plot: While the police suspect a drug dealer on trial is behind the murders of the State's witness in his case, as well as his girlfriend, Patrick Jane sees a different motive for the crime -- as well as a different suspect.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E09 - Flame Red
1.plot: Patrick Jane suspects the only surviving member of a National Guard unit of murdering his friends - and goes undercover to prove it.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E10 - Red Brick and Ivy
1.plot: When a leading scientific researcher is killed by poisoning, Patrick Jane takes a personal interest in the case when he learns the prime suspect is the victim's wife - and Jane's former psychiatrist.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E11 - Red John's Friends
1.plot: Enticed by the promise from a convicted murder that he'll reveal information about Red John upon his release, Patrick Jane becomes singularly focused and quits the CBI in order to prove the prisoner is innocent.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E12 - Red Rum
1.plot: Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap to find out who is responsible for the murder of a high school boy who antagonized the local self-proclaimed witch by killing her cat.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E13 - Paint It Red
1.plot: While it appears obvious that a business tycoon's son-in-law was in on the robbery of a $50 million painting since his body is found where the painting once hung, Patrick Jane suspects others, including a Russian oil baron, an art forger and an art curator.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E14 - Crimson Casanova
1.plot: With Patrick Jane's help, Cho goes undercover as a sweet-talking ladies man with all the right moves in order to catch a pick-up artist and killer with his own set of pseudo-mentalist techniques.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E15 - Scarlett Fever
1.plot: As Jane and the team investigate the poisoning death of the "queen bee" in a country club, they discover that the community is full of secrets, including love affairs and drug abuse

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E16 - Bloodshot
1.plot: Patrick Jane must rely on his other senses during the murder investigation of a financial advisor when he loses his sight as a result of an explosion.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E17 - Carnelian Inc.
1.plot: A story of greed and betrayal pits Patrick Jane against a group of financiers when the CBI investigates a series of murders at a corporate retreat in the wilds of the Sierra Nevada foothills.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E18 - Russet Potatoes
1.plot: Patrick Jane and the CBI team track down a mastermind who hypnotizes people into doing their bidding.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E19 - A Dozen Red Roses
1.plot: Patrick Jane and the team go to Hollywood when they investigate the murder of a movie producer.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E20 - Red Sauce
1.plot: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of a mobster who was in the witness protection program.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E21 - Miss Red
1.plot: Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to play suspects off each other in order to solve the case of a wealthy software company CEO found murdered on his yacht.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E22 - Blood Brothers
1.plot: Patrick Jane must find a clever way to convince the troubled kids in a wilderness program to confide in him about what really happened surrounding the death of one of their peers.

1.title: FR - Mentalist - S01E23 - Red John's Footsteps
1.plot: Lisbon fears that the serial killer Red John is drawing Patrick Jane into a trap when the CBI team investigates the murder of a young girl and the abduction of her twin sister.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E01 - Redemption
2.plot: Jane and Lisbon learn that the Red John case has been reassigned to a different CBI team led by the straight-shooting officer Sam Bosco.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E02 - The Scarlet Letter
2.plot: Lisbon and the team work the case of a State Senator's murdered intern, while Jane simultaneously tries to find out what new information Bosco has uncovered on the Red John case.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E03 - Red Badge
2.plot: Jane, Cho, Rigsby and Van Pelt decide to conduct their own investigation when Lisbon is accused of murdering a child molester she arrested who was recently paroled.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E04 - Red Menace
2.plot: Jane and the CBI investigate the murder of Gordon Hodge, a powerful attorney, who is responsible for allowing a vicious murderer, Van McBride, to walk away a free man.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E05 - Red Scare
2.plot: Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the death of a prominent architect found murdered in a crumbling old mansion, and there appears to be a number of suspects.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E06 - Black Gold and Red Blood
2.plot: Even after Bosco arrests Jane and puts him in prison for spying on him, Jane is able to help the CBI team from his cell to solve the murder of a young man.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E07 - Red Bulls
2.plot: Minelli orders Patrick Jane and Lisbon and company to play nice and work together with Bosco and his team to locate a kidnapped woman being held for ransom.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E08 - His Red Right Hand
2.plot: The CBI team is faced with a violent and shocking crime in their own office, but must work the case in spite of their alarm of who may be behind it. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt are definitely an "item".

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E09 - A Price Above Rubies
2.plot: Patrick Jane and the team are called to investigate the robbery and murder of a wealthy jeweler while attending a black tie fundraiser for the CBI.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E10 - Throwing Fire
2.plot: While Jane and the team examine the crime scene where a baseball scout is found murdered, Jane is clocked in the head by a ball and flashes back to his childhood with his overbearing father.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E11 - Rose-Colored Glasses
2.plot: Jane and company investigate the murder of a man and his wife, on her way to his fifteen year high school reunion where, clearly, the attendees haven't changed all that much.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E12 - Bleeding Heart
2.plot: Patrick Jane and the team investigate the murder of a mayor's aide, and Rigsby and Van Pelt make a big announcement.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E13 - Redline
2.plot: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate when the body of a high-end luxury car sales woman is found in the trunk of a Bentley in the dealership's showroom.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E14 - Blood In, Blood Out
2.plot: When a member of Cho's former gang, the Avon Park Playboys, is found murdered, Patrick Jane insists on helping Cho with his off-the-books investigation.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E15 - Red Herring
2.plot: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an arrogant chef during a cooking competition in Napa Valley.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E16 - Code Red
2.plot: When Dr. Alicia Seberg, a government research scientist, is exposed to a deadly toxin while at work and has only hours to live, she calls Patrick Jane and the CBI to find her murderer.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E17 - The Red Box
2.plot: Patrick and the CBI team investigate the murder of a tutor, and find a mysterious little red box near the body, starting a chain of events that turns the murder into the search for a priceless ring stolen from the British Museum. Meanwhile, Lisbon is worried when a new boss, Madeleine Hightower, takes command of the CBI, as well as mysteriously learning about Rigsby and Van Pelt's relationship.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E18 - Aingavite Baa
2.plot: When a "Jane Doe" with amnesia and covered in blood steps in front of Cho and Van Pelt's car, Patrick Jane must use all of his skills to discover who she is, her last location and why she lost her memory

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E19 - Blood Money
2.plot: When Patrick Jane's sneaky conduct causes the case of a confessed hitman to be tossed out of court, his annoyed CBI team must start the investigation over from scratch.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E20 - Red All Over
2.plot: When a media mogul is murdered, Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate cult leader Bret Stiles, who may have had an axe to grind following the publication of a critical story about his group.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E21 - 18-5-4
2.plot: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the death of a mathematical genius by a gun-wielding clown.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E22 - Red Letter
2.plot: Romantic sparks begin to fly when Patrick Jane and supposed psychic Kristina Frye cross paths again during the CBI investigation into the murder of a charismatic head of a non-profit organization that fights human trafficking.

2.title: FR - Mentalist - S02E23 - Red Sky in the Morning
2.plot: Patrick Jane and Kristina's first date is interrupted by a report of Red John striking again, which is discovered to be a copycat. But when Kristina reaches out to the real Red John, both she and Jane find themselves in grave danger.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E01 - Red Sky at Night
3.plot: When the CBI investigates the kidnapping of a prominent lawyer and state house lobbyist, the CBI Director wants Jane on the case, but he is uncertain of his future with the unit after his encounter with Red John.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E02 - Cackle-Bladder Blood
3.plot: When Jane's brother-in-law returns to town and gets mixed up in a murder investigation, Jane must come to his aid despite personal reservations.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E03 - The Blood on His Hands
3.plot: When Patrick Jane faces off once again with cult leader Bret Stiles, Stiles offers Jane information regarding Red John and the missing Kristina Frye.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E04 - Red Carpet Treatment
3.plot: Patrick Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the murder of a convict who served nine years for rape and murder, but was recently released on DNA evidence.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E05 - The Red Ponies
3.plot: Patrick Jane and the CBI team hit the horse track when a jockey is found murdered and suspects abound.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E06 - Pink Chanel Suit
3.plot: The case of a murder and missing person on an intensely secure wealthy family's compound perplexes Jane and the CBI team.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E07 - Red Hot
3.plot: Jane and the CBI team narrowly escape a fiery end when a building explodes while they're investigating a death threat. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and billionaire Walter Mashburn when they meet again while on the case.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E08 - Ball of Fire
3.plot: When Jane is kidnapped, Lisbon and the team realize there are many suspects who might want to harm him.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E09 - Red Moon
3.plot: Patrick Jane accepts the help of a local astrologer, Ellis Mars, to solve the puzzling case of a triple homicide that involves two policemen and the fiancé of an EMT worker.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E10 - Jolly Red Elf
3.plot: The CBI pursues two lines of investigation when a Santa is murdered: Patrick Jane goes undercover in an AA group; and Rigsby and Van Pelt question members of an authentic Santa society. Meanwhile, following the demise of a person in custody at the CBI, J.J. LaRoche is brought in to question the team when it appears to be an inside job.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E11 - Bloodsport
3.plot: Patrick and the team investigate the murder of a woman with ties to one of the fighters. Meanwhile, LaRoche focuses his investigation on Rigsby, who in turn is forced to ask Cho for a huge favor in order to keep his job.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E12 - Bloodhounds
3.plot: When Patrick Jane and the CBI must work with a criminal profiler, Dr. Montague, to solve a double murder, it becomes a competition for Jane to prove that his methods are superior.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E13 - Red Alert
3.plot: When Patrick Jane and others are taken hostage by an armed man accused of murder, Jane must think quickly to defuse the situation.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E14 - Blood for Blood
3.plot: Van Pelt's actions are called into question when a witness is murdered while she is assigned to his protection.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E15 - Red Gold
3.plot: When a modern-day prospector is found dead near a mining site and Lisbon is injured during the initial stages of the investigation, Agent Hightower joins Patrick Jane in the field for the first time.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E16 - Red Queen
3.plot: Evidence in the murder of an antiques dealer found dead in a museum indicates that the suspect may be a member of the CBI team.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E17 - Bloodstream
3.plot: After a doctor is found dead at a golf course, the CBI team searches for a killer amongst a hospital's staff and patients. Meanwhile, when LaRoche is placed in charge of the CBI, his first act of business is to name Cho the new team leader.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E18 - The Red Mile
3.plot: Patrick Jane and the CBI team must track down the killer of a man who believed he experienced an alien abduction - even after the victim's body is stolen from the coroner's van. Meanwhile, Van Pelt takes a break from the case to shop for wedding dresses.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E19 - Every Rose Has Its Thorn
3.plot: Patrick Jane sets out to prove a beautiful yet manipulative matchmaker shot and killed her husband after his body is found floating in the marina.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E20 - Redacted
3.plot: Patrick Jane must deal with two failed robbery attempts: one resulting in the murder of a repair shop owner and the other involving a former suspect personally hired by Jane to break into LaRoche's home.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E21 - Like a Redheaded Stepchild
3.plot: When a prison guard is stabbed to death outside of a jewelry store, Patrick Jane suspects one of the guard's inmates is the killer. Meanwhile, Rigsby questions his own father about the murder.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E22 - Rhapsody in Red
3.plot: After a young violinist is shot to death, Patrick Jane questions the members of the Northern California Symphony Orchestra about the murder. Meanwhile, Cho crosses paths with a precocious young pickpocket.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E23 - Strawberries and Cream (1)
3.plot: A robber with a bomb attached to him is blown up in front of a convenience store, and CBI soon discovers that there may be connections between this case and Red John and agent Hightower.

3.title: FR - Mentalist - S03E24 - Strawberries and Cream (2)
3.plot: Patrick trades Hightower's secret location to Laroche for the four remaining names on his list. The team then sets up a trap to uncover Red John's real informant, leading to a possible face-to-face showdown between Patrick and Red John.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E01 - Scarlet Ribbons
4.plot: In prison for killing his nemesis, Patrick Jane must prove that the man he shot really was Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon urges Van Pelt to seek counseling in the aftermath of the death of her fiancé.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E02 - Little Red Book
4.plot: With Lisbon suspended and the rest of the team reassigned, Jane is reinstated as a CBI consultant and forced to work with a new team. During the investigation, Jane conspires to bring his former team back together.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E03 - Pretty Red Balloon
4.plot: When the son of a former client from Jane's days as a psychic is kidnapped, Jane and the CBI team are asked to help find him. Meanwhile, Jane butts heads with his former client's new "spiritual advisor."

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E04 - Ring Around the Rosie
4.plot: Jane notices a suspicious-looking man carrying a gun at a political rally and sets out to prove he's a psychopath on the brink of committing murder. Meanwhile, Lisbon investigates the death of a photographer at the same rally.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E05 - Blood and Sand
4.plot: The CBI team investigates the murder of a woman whose corpse washed up on an island off the coast of California. Rigsby worries that his relationship with a public defender will create awkwardness between him and Van Pelt.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E06 - Where in the World Is Carmine O'Brien?
4.plot: When the CBI team travels to a resort town to find out who murdered a police chief, Lisbon crosses paths with her brother Tommy, now a bounty hunter, who's tracking a bail jumper.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E07 - Blinking Red Light
4.plot: The search for a serial killer hits close to home for Jane when he encounters a blogger who has devoted his life to finding the killer.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E08 - Pink Tops
4.plot: In order to find the killer of an undercover narcotics cop, Jane and the CBI team retrace her investigation.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E09 - The Redshirt
4.plot: Jane and the CBI investigate when a retired NFL star quarterback is presumed dead after his car blows up. Meanwhile, while preparing for a court case, Rigsby and Harrigan take their relationship to the next level.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E10 - Fugue in Red
4.plot: During the search for a firefighter's killer, Jane is attacked and nearly drowned, resulting in a temporary loss of his memory and a return to his pre-CBI con man persona.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E11 - Always Bet on Red
4.plot: Jane and the CBI team narrow down the long list of suspects after a high-end divorce attorney, with many enemies, is killed on his speed boat. Meanwhile, Jane is questioned by Agent Darcy about whether Red John was responsible for Panzer's murder.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E12 - My Bloody Valentine
4.plot: With very little evidence, Jane and the CBI investigate the death of a mob boss’ son. Meanwhile, while taking an eyewitness in for questioning, Van Pelt is haunted by the memories of O’Laughlin’s shooting.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E13 - Red Is the New Black
4.plot: Jane and the CBI narrow down the list of suspects after a disgraced clothing designer on the verge of a comeback becomes a fashion victim. Meanwhile, FBI Agent Darcy continues her investigation into finding Red John.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E14 - At First Blush
4.plot: While a jury deliberates the guilt or innocence of a defendant on trial for murder, Jane tries to prove she has been wrongfully accused before time runs out. Meanwhile, Summer may have gone too far when she helps Cho make a case against a suspect.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E15 - War of the Roses
4.plot: When a charity worker is killed, Jane has Erica Flynn, a murderer he helped imprison, furloughed in exchange for information she claims to have about the case. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Sarah try to adjust to impending parenthood.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E16 - His Thoughts Were Red Thoughts
4.plot: Jane is reunited with his former nemesis, cult leader Bret Stiles, when the head of an anti-cult activist organization is murdered.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E17 - Cheap Burgundy
4.plot: Jane suspects that Agent Susan Darcy has ulterior motives when she asks for his help with a homicide investigation. Meanwhile, the CBI team handles the murder of a young woman who was killed after meeting someone in an online chat room.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E18 - Ruddy Cheeks
4.plot: Jane and the CBI try to narrow down the list of suspects when a terminally ill man, is found murdered. Meanwhile, Cho is forced to face his demons.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E19 - Pink Champagne on Ice
4.plot: While investigating the murder of a casino employee, Jane runs into a stage magician he used to tour with during his time as a mentalist and discovers he is hiding a shocking secret.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E20 - Something's Rotten in Redmund
4.plot: Jane and the CBI try to determine who would have reason to kill a popular English teacher, and Rigsby nervously awaits a special delivery.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E21 - Ruby Slippers
4.plot: Jane and the CBI try to find the killer of a man found outside a cabaret featuring female impersonators. During the investigation they discover a list of suspects, all of whom bullied the victim. Meanwhile, Cho and Summer hide their relationship from Lisbon.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E22 - So Long, and Thanks for All the Red Snapper
4.plot: While investigating the murder of a surfer, Lisbon reconnects with her former fiancé, Kenny Johnson, who she hasn't seen in over a decade. Also, Cho questions his decision to be in a relationship with Summer.

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E23 - Red Rover, Red Rover
4.plot: On the ninth anniversary of his wife and daughter's death, Jane receives a message from Red John, causing Jane to lose focus on his current case and put the investigation and his career at the CBI in jeopardy

4.title: FR - Mentalist - S04E24 - The Crimson Hat
4.plot: After another failed attempt to defeat Red John, Patrick Jane hits rock bottom, finds a lover and shoots one of his own.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E01 - The Crimson Ticket
5.plot: While Jane tries to decipher Lorelei’s connection to Red John, the CBI team is forced to partner with the FBI to solve the murder of a hotel employee.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E02 - Devil's Cherry
5.plot: While the team investigates the murder of a diamond cutter, Jane meets a girl who claims to be his late daughter, Charlotte.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E03 - Not One Red Cent
5.plot: A bank employee is murdered during a heist and Jane and the team must work to track down the killer. Meanwhile, Lisbon is pulled deeper into the CBI/FBI rivalry.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E04 - Blood Feud
5.plot: When Rigsby’s father is found injured at a crime scene, the team must find out if it is the result of a long-standing small-town gang war.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E05 - Red Dawn
5.plot: See how Jane met Lisbon and the rest of the CBI team for the first time.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E06 - Cherry Picked
5.plot: The team investigates the kidnapping of a couple that may be the victim of mistaken identity, while Jane continues his investigation into Lorelei's whereabouts.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E07 - If It Bleeds, It Leads
5.plot: The team investigates the murder of a reporter who may have become too close to her story, while Jane insists on pursuing his own leads to find Lorelei.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E08 - Red Sails in the Sunset
5.plot: With the help of Brett Stiles, Jane orchestrates an elaborate plan to break Lorelei Martins out of prison in the hopes of her leading him to Red John.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E09 - Black Cherry
5.plot: The CBI team investigates the murder of a real estate agent with former gang ties, while Jane searches for leads on his new connection to Red John.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E10 - Panama Red
5.plot: The death of a young botanist leads the team into the lucrative world of medical marijuana, while Cho’s work with the rapid response team brings him back into contact with Summer.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E11 - Days of Wine and Roses
5.plot: The CBI team visits a high-end California rehab center in order to investigate the death of a young model who was a patient there, while Lisbon ramps up her investigation into Tommy Volker.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E12 - Little Red Corvette
5.plot: The CBI investigates the death of a geologist, which Lisbon is convinced is the key to bringing down Tommy Volker.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E13 - The Red Barn
5.plot: The team investigates a 25-year-old case that seems to involve both Red John and the Visualize group, and Lisbon contemplates her future.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E14 - Red in Tooth and Claw
5.plot: The team delves into the surprisingly cutthroat world of academics in a case involving a graduate student at a natural history museum.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E15 - Red Lacquer Nail Polish
5.plot: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an elderly heiress whose remains are found in the living room of her spooky mansion.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E16 - There Will Be Blood
5.plot: Lorelei Martins returns, determined to find out if Red John had a role in her sister's death, and Jane is forced to confess to Lisbon his part in Lorelei's prison escape.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E17 - Red, White and Blue
5.plot: The CBI team investigates when the body of a female army medic who worked with soldiers with PTSD is found near a military base.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E18 - Behind the Red Curtain
5.plot: The CBI team investigates when the young lead of a local theater production dies on the eve of the opening. Meanwhile, Jane hopes to get more information about Red John from the comatose Jason Lennon.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E19 - Red Letter Day
5.plot: The CBI team heads out to a run-down Wild West tourist town to investigate the death of the town's owner. Meanwhile, Kirkland tries to uncover the extent of Jane's knowledge about Red John.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E20 - Red Velvet Cupcakes
5.plot: Rigsby and Van Pelt go undercover as a couple with relationship problems to investigate the death of a woman who received advice from a radio love doctor.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E21 - Red and Itchy
5.plot: J.J. LaRoche personally requests Jane’s help when the mysterious container he’s been hiding for nine years is stolen from his home.

5.title: FR - Mentalist - S05E22 - Red John's Rules
5.plot: Just as Jane narrows down the Red John suspect list to seven, Red John strikes again, and the victim has a link to Jane’s past.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E01 - The Desert Rose
6.plot: Jane and Lisbon secretly continue their mission to narrow down the list of seven Red John suspects as they investigate the murder of a man who was missing for two years.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E02 - Black-Winged Redbird
6.plot: Jane discovers an important clue to Red John's methods as the team  encounters four of the suspects, and the CBI investigates the case of a  software engineer killed by a drone strike.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E03 - Wedding in Red
6.plot: Jane gets the CBI involved in a case in Napa in order to focus on Sheriff McAllister, while Van Pelt and Rigsby take a trip down the aisle.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E04 - Red Listed
6.plot: Jane reveals that a list of fake Red John suspects he planted was stolen, and the team realizes these men are in danger.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E05 - The Red Tattoo
6.plot: When a prominent member of Visualize is mysteriously killed, Jane investigates in the hopes that the case will provide a clue that will lead him to Red John.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E06 - Fire and Brimstone
6.plot: With the final clue in hand, Jane attempts to gather the remaining Red John suspects in one place in hopes of finally revealing his identity.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E07 - The Great Red Dragon
6.plot: Following the shocking events at Jane's house, the Red John list is  narrowed down further, and the CBI's priority is the remaining suspects.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E08 - Red John
6.plot: Patrick Jane finally comes face-to-face with Red John, the serial killer he’s tracked since the madman murdered his wife and daughter. For 10 years, Jane has doggedly hunted his nemesis in his search for justice.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E09 - My Blue Heaven
6.plot: Two years after the Red John case was  put to rest, Jane's newfound  peace is interrupted by a surprising job offer that could change  everything for him.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E10 - Green Thumb
6.plot: The FBI reluctantly enlists Jane’s help to find a missing computer programmer, but he won’t help unless Lisbon is brought on board as well.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E11 - White Lines
6.plot: The FBI is tasked with finding the killer of several DEA agents, and Jane goes on a date with a beautiful woman associated with the case.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E12 - The Golden Hammer
6.plot: Jane and the FBI investigate the murder of a high-tech cartographer who may have unearthed a spy ring before his death. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt find themselves on the trail of an alarming conspiracy.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E13 - Black Helicopters
6.plot: Jane's investigation leads him to join a separatist commune after a U.S.  attorney is found dead in Mexico, even though there's no record of her  crossing  the border.  Also, Rigsby and Van Pelt convince J.J. LaRoche to  help them discover who is stalking former CBI members.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E14 - Grey Water
6.plot: Jane and Fischer investigate a murder at an oil fracking site, while Rigsby and Van Pelt travel to Austin to help investigate suspects in the string of attacks on former CBI team members.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E15 - White as the Driven Snow
6.plot: Grace is kidnapped by the killer who has been hunting former CBI members, but when the prime suspect appears to have an airtight alibi, Jane must rely on all his skills to locate her before time runs out.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E16 - Violets
6.plot: Jane enlists his colleagues in a dangerous sting operation to catch a deadly team of art thieves. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and an agent from the FBI’s art squad.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E17 - Silver Wings of Time
6.plot: Jane and the FBI take up the cause of a death row inmate who has two days to prove his innocence before his sentence is carried out.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E18 - Forest Green
6.plot: When a woman is found murdered near a remote men’s social club, Jane must find a way to insinuate himself into the insular group to find the killer.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E19 - Brown Eyed Girls
6.plot: A chance encounter with a suspicious-looking individual leads Jane and Lisbon to uncover a vast human smuggling ring. Meanwhile, Lisbon remains tempted by Pike’s offer to move to D.C. with him.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E20 - Il Tavolo Bianco
6.plot: Jane’s freedom is at stake when a grand jury is empanelled to decide if he should be tried for the murder of Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon tries to find out how Jane feels about the possibility of her leaving Austin with Agent Pike, and Cho and Abbott follow new leads in the human smuggling ring they recently uncovered.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E21 - Black Hearts
6.plot: With time running out to save the victims of a kidnapping ring before they are transported overseas, Jane and Lisbon zero in on the criminal enterprise’s mastermind. Meanwhile, Lisbon decides if she will move to D.C. with Agent Pike.

6.title: FR - Mentalist - S06E22 - Blue Bird
6.plot: A new lead in a cold case requires Lisbon to delay her plans to leave for Washington, D.C., giving Jane time to finally come to terms with his feelings for her and decide on a course of action.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E01 - Nothing But Blue Skies
7.plot: Jane and Lisbon decide to keep their new relationship a secret from  their colleagues as they investigate the murder of an undercover agent.  Also, young, ambitious agent Michelle Vega joins the team.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E02 - The Greybar Hotel
7.plot: Lisbon goes undercover as a prison inmate in order to get a convict to turn on her boyfriend, who is the leader of a high-end car theft ring.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E03 - Orange Blossom Ice Cream
7.plot: Jane and Lisbon travel to Beirut where they must work with Jane's familiar adversary Erica Flynn, who agrees to help the FBI apprehend her boyfriend, a courier for terrorist organizations, in exchange for amnesty for her past crimes.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E04 - Black Market
7.plot: The team investigates a murder linked to a counterfeit diamond operation, but an illness forces Jane to direct his colleagues from the office as he recuperates. Meanwhile, Abbott is concerned that transgressions in his past could harm his wife’s chance to obtain a prestigious job in Washington, D.C.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E05 - The Silver Briefcase
7.plot: A chance encounter with a military colonel leads Jane to believe the soldier is hiding something, leading him to dig into closed murder case of the man’s wife.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E06 - Green Light
7.plot: The team is brought in to consult on a botched DEA raid, but when Abbott’s former boss tries to blackmail him into keeping the agency’s missteps quiet, Abbott is forced to choose between his career and his morals.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E07 - Little Yellow House
7.plot: A murder investigation becomes personal for Lisbon when she learns that her underachieving younger brother, Jimmy, is being sought as a key witness.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E08 - The Whites of His Eyes
7.plot: Jane worries for Lisbon’s safety when the team puts itself in the line of fire to protect the witness in a murder investigation from a skilled assassin.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E09 - Copper Bullet
7.plot: When Abbott's old boss, Agent Peterson, threatens Abbott's career - and possibly his freedom - Jane devises a risky plan to protect his friend's  future.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E10 - Nothing Gold Can Stay
7.plot: Jane takes extreme measures as the team tries to apprehend a deadly gang of armored car robbers before their desperation to remain free costs more innocent people their lives.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E11 - Byzantium
7.plot: A young man claiming to have psychic powers offers his help to the FBI in solving a pair of murders, but when he leads them to additional victims, Jane and the team begin to suspect that he is in fact the killer they're hunting.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E12 - Brown Shag Carpet
7.plot: Jane agrees to once again pretend to be a renowned psychic and be used as bait in an attempt to lure out a serial killer and give the FBI a chance to apprehend him.

7.title: FR - Mentalist - S07E13 - White Orchids
7.plot: Lisbon accepts Jane's surprise marriage proposal, but a killer's quest for revenge may cost them the happy ending they've worked so hard to achieve.

meta.plot: Un mentaliste utilise ses extraordinaires dons d'observation pour résoudre des crimes en tant que consultant du CBI. Une façon pour lui de contribuer à la justice et de démasquer le mystérieux tueur en série qui a assassiné son épouse et sa fille...
